title: Lost Baggage Indigo Airlines
text:
I felt compelled to write this review on Indigo Airlines re our trip Goa to Delhi last nonth on 15th October. my wife and I had been travelling around India for 3 weeks and had a marvellous time. My wife had bought quite a lot of materials, saris and for a few other items for her cottage fashion industry back home in New Zealand. We had an extra bag of 23 odd kilos for these special items we'd ammassed during our trip. we arrived in Delhi at around 8.00pm and had one night booked in an airport hotel as we were flying back to New Zealand the next morning leaving at 7.00am.
Imagine our disappointment when at the luggage carousal at Delhi Airport when all luggage had been collected and we are the last people standing there with only 2 of our bags collected. The carousal stopped and we were left wondering what to do. We found one official looking person and he said to go down the other end of the domestic terminal and file a missing bag report. We eventually did find a counter with some chap behind who spoke very little English but understood we had lost a bag and told us to fill out a form and he'd see what he could do. I thought that is the end of us having any chance to see our special bag again especially with flying out earlythe next day. He took the form and told us to wait and he was on the phone ringing around I dont know who! After about 20 minutes he said he had locate the bag and it had gone to another cit -cant remember where but never heard of it. He asked us to write down where we were staying and said they'd try to get it back and give us a ring and deliver to hotel... Yeh right we'd be at the hotel about 10.00pm and leaving from International. my wife made 2-3 calls to Indigo from our hotel, very upset! Finally at 1.00am her mobile phone rang and said the bag had arrived in Delhi and theyed get it to the Indigo information counter at Delhi International in time for us to pick up around 5.00am. Well, can you imagine our surprise we we arrived at Delhi International, finally found the Indigo counter and there up above the woman in the booth on the top shelve was our big bag!!!! Unbelievable!
We just could believe that in that short space of time overnight thay had located our bag from another city, found a flight and then arranged to deliever it from Deomestic to International some 40 minutes away! Then to have it waiting for us!!!! 
That is absolutely amazing unbelievable service and something I will always remember about Indigo Air. I thought we'd never see that special bag again!
 In Nz we have a saying from a local company "that it the putting right that counts!"
Indigo Air you did us proud!!!
and yes otherwise the flight service was bloody good too!

title: Could be better
text: There is no doubt that Indigo is the cheapest airline in this route. The problem is even on the international sectors the planes are the same and the food is the same. title: Good on time flight
text:
I am travelling this morning, 10th Nov 2019, from Kolkata to Shillong on Indigo flight 6E 7962. The scheduled departure  was at 9.45 and I reached airport at 7.30. Following is my overall experience about the flight ( Rating given out of 5, 5 being the highest):-
A. Check-in: I had my tele check-in done and boarding pass printed at the airport kiosk. Travelling with Hand Baggage .(Rating 4).
B. Lounge access: I was flying economy and hence there was no lounge faculty offered. I used my Mastercard to access airport lounge.(Rating Neutral)
C. Boarding and departure: There was lot of chaos at Kolkata Airport due to 12 hours closure of the airport from 6 pm of previous day to 6 am this morning. Flight was on time. In spite, boarding was smoothe and on time. Gate opened at 09.30 at Gate 23C by Bus. Push back was at 9.59 and we took off at 10.15 after long waiting at taxi way. (Rating 4). 
D. Seats and interior: The aircraft was a ATR 72-600 series and looked new and maintained. Interior looked fresh. Seats upholstered in signature blue of Indigo was comfortable. Seating was in 2x2 format and My selected seat was 8A, an aisle seat at the middle. Seat pitch was comfortable legspace was good. Seats does not recline, being small aircraft.(Rating 4.25).
E. In flight Service: Being no frill flight food can get bought in flight. I didn't try bought out food being served . (Rating Neutral).
F. Arrival and baggage: Landing was smooth. Flight landed at 11.40, Gates were opened at 11.45. I didn't have any checked in baggage.(Rating 4)
G.Overall flight experience and suggested area of improvement : Good service, nice aircraft, almost on time arrival. (OVERALL RATING 4.25)

title: Very lackadaisical approach
text:
We were returning back to our city from our recent trip to Kolkata on account of some official work of my husband. It was an afternoon flight to reach here in the evening. 

At the airport itself we saw the lackadaisical approach of the Indigo ground staff at the check-in baggage counter. There was absolutely no coordination and pretending not to understand the language. Little did they know that I hail from the same city and had to raise my voice in local language to make them understand. They refused us on one side of the counters saying it's closed owing to problem in the conversation belt and made all of us queue up on the other side. As soon as about a couple of passengers had finished checking-in, one of the ground staff asked us to go back to the old counter saying the belt was working now. On reaching this Indigo counter, however we had more in store. We were told to go some distance opposite the counter and pass the baggage through the machine first and come back. The flight as usual was delayed which is not a surprise however😊 Post that after boarding the flight which was also a struggle because they couldn't manage efficiently the queuing for boarding also. There was a long wait on the aero bridge and then double queuing occured and people started shouting. Hardly any response of the staff to set things ✔

Best ordeal was expecting us on the flight. Since it's a considerably long flight of about 3 hrs approx, we had ordered Veg Biriyani for my husband and myself. Now when we see the hotels and the sourcing from where the flight catering is done we expect at least a decent meal. But to our utter surprise, when the food and beverage services started, we were alarmed. Came finally our turn and we were handed over two "Cup Biriyani" After adding hot water and been asked to open after 8 minutes 😂 !! We looked at each other wondering what to do. When we tried to open one of them, it was too dry and absolutely tasteless, much worse than the cup noodles the kids have!! When we asked the purser, she just sniled and said we only serve ready to eat meals!! Sourcing from such expensive outlets can you imagine!! 

Really I tell you does Indigo think we are a bunch of kids travelling for fun for 3 hours and doing us a favour by serving meals that we have paid for!!!

Indigo the airline in India in my experience,  the name is a misnomer  

All is well,if your flight takes off on time and you land with your checked in baggage at your destination, safe n sound .

But if you have any issues at all  other than a perfect flight stated above God should bestow upon you all the patience & tolerances , in the world for:

 It has a thousand faces who work in 
 the airline but there will be none 
 to  be approached by people who 
 have issues or sufferred by flying 
 with them.

 They are left with only a number that 
 connects one to a faceless call
 centre reresentative in a remote 
 office in Delhi who is trained to talk 
 like a robot thus:

 "My name is .....How can I help you    
   sir" . 
You explain in detail your issue.
 His stock reply would be :

" We are very sorry sir for your   inconveniences .Let me check and get back to you .Can I put you on hold" You have no choice but to say yes.

Then my friends please  braze yourself for listening to minimum 15 to 20  minutes of their Sogam music that  will be a pain in your ears . Hopefully if he comes back on line after you wait for 20 mts on line 
 his stock reply will be:

 " Sorry Sir to put you on hold .I have checked your registered complaint .Our people are looking     
 into it and we will get back to you soon ."

You push him, then he will say one hour . 

Friends dont take their word , for they wont say from what time and in GMT or IST.Any way that response will never  come .You can contend yourself with enjoying DD type of music with same stock reply how many ever times you call over the next 48 hours or so and  I dont  know what happens  after that .

God be with  one who travels  by  their international flight and finds to his or her dismay the baggage has not arrived in the same flight as booked .

Lets say the airline has lost it in transit or not loaded it at all at the airport of embarkation .Their standard  rule is they will need 48 hours to  respond after one  files  a written complaint at the disembarkation  airport 

In a foreign country your booked  suitcase that conforms to their baggage rules for weight and size , is lost ,one is  left with nothing but what one is wearing . Minimum 48 hours is what they will tell,  to get back to but  not the suitcase itself .

Assuming one  is travelling to different places on an iternary he or she  is sunk .One  has  to head to a nearest  departmental store to buy everything one needs for the  daily needs, to survive with meagre foreign exchange at hand .

Oh imagine what a state to be in .!😥
  
Personally speaking I lost my baggage travelling on 4th Nov on a direct flight from Hyderabad to chennai, just an hours flight . Unfortunately and stupidly  ,  I kept my life saving daibetic medicines  along with cool pack in that suitcase, to avoid nuisance in security gate where they tell you to remove everything other than your clothes and Undy.

The flight scheduled for 9 15 pm took off at 1115 pm with a delay of 2 hours and.l landed at 1230 past midnight .My suitcase was missing on conveyor belt . Another hour was spent trying to locate it with no result .A written complaint  had to be filled keeping the ticket and tab in hand fortunately for I tend to discard on landing .

Now its 7th Thursday morning   and I have kept calling  their customer care several times during last 48 hours and the  same reply is being dished out with long sole music .

My efforts to talk to GMR Airport  customer care only resulted in their telling me that  they can offer no assistance and I have to deal only with Indigo.
 
I found all my google search to find any duty officer in Chennai or Hyderabad turned futile .All lines lead to Delhi call centre only .

You canot talk to any employee or officer in the Airline , for there is none to access by phone nor office to approach .You will only draw Just a blank except  for a moronic customer care number  in Delhi I mentioned at the beginning of my post .Even if you decide to go to the airline ticketing office in the airport,  you will get no assistance and they will dish out the same customer care number of Delhi to follow up.No more help.

I am not posting this out of frustration of loosing my valuable life saving medicines with my baggage that had to be kept cool through ice pack for the duration of a flight but to give  travellers an insight of what they will have in store  if they end up with any issues at all with the airline and to help them braze themselves for what they will be upto if they too land in a situation like mine .

I now realise I have to grin and bear it or forget about  my belongings lost by airline and move on.

It will be a hellavu  to fight with this monopolist airline with all  their rules and regulation for any compensation when their bosses themselves are slugging it out in US courts and facing serious concerns with DGCA with their faulty engines on Airbus A320 Neo their main stay aircrafts .

title: Efficient and comfortable at every stage

title: The worst airlines to fly overseas
text:
I had booked a Sweden-Delhi Turkish Airlines flight and had no idea that the airlines had partnered with Indigo Airlines for the Istanbul-Delhi leg. It was the worst airlines experience of my life because first in the main ticket it was written in very small letters that Indigo was the code-shared airlines. When I asked my travel agent to book my ticket I asked him to book on Turkish and not budget airlines.

I have travelled on several budget airlines including indigo, which was not a bad experience but this one crossed all heights. The staff was super slow and more interested in having conversations with fellow passengers and among themselves than serve the customers. For a 7.5 hours long flight taking off at dinner time, there were no hot meals onboard except for unhealthy maggie noddles. The sandwiches were so old and hard that you can use them as a weapon to hurt someone. I literally had to plead them for food. 

The seats were damn uncomfortable with very less leg space. Obviously, being a budget airline there was no inflight entertainment. It was a very noisy airline and every person around me seem to have an issue with the airlines. There were many on board who said that the airline didn't deliver their luggage for over five days. 

Despite officially complaining about their service and follow-ups, no solution was given.

Overall a horrible experience. Travel with Indigo Airlines overseas only when you don; have an option.

title: Ok...
text: This wasn’t the worst experience a person could have or the worst airline. title: (International flight) Never before never again
text:
We booked tickets from Amsterdam to Delhi. It showed that tickets were for code share flights. I got multiple emails telling me how awesome they are and how can I save time by doing online checkin. When I try, their site denies me. I could check in on Turkish airlines though for their legs. 

At Amsterdam, Indigo's faulty systems cannot print boarding passes. So, we had to get them from Istanbul airport which is long freaking walk. 

Finally when we got the passes, we went back to gate only to see that a flight at 1950 had last call showing at 1902 and it still took ages to complete boarding and take off.

Here is when freak show begins. The plane they use is same as one in domestic flight. They did not provide seat belt for infants. There is no entertainment system, no meals on a almost 6 hour flight. Everything was to be purchased.

We had booked special meals for complete trip by, call with Turkish airlines and on their leg things were great. But on Indigo, my wife was 11th person to be served and they already had shortage of food. Then for next 3 hours there was continued disappointment from fellow passengers. People who did not had cash in freaking USD or EUR, or change or those who do not use credit cards, had to starve.

Overall, never before, never again.

Here are some more ideas indigo,

1. Remove toilets from planes. You can fit some more seats there.
2. If you wish to keep them, make that a paid addon.
3. Make bitcoin only way to pay for everything (good luck doing it without internet)
4. Make crew interaction for anything a paid service so lesser people bother them and you make more money (they anyways visibly hate their job because they are the ones facing your customers who are piisse)

Food for sale on board, but the items on the menu are rarely there. I just wanted a Diet Coke, but haven’t  got one on Indigo for more than a year now.

It’s the back end which needs catching up with their growing market share.

title: In the air with IndiGo
text:
The personnel manning the baggage scanning and check-in were helpful and courteous. The flight was on time. The cabin crew were nice and hospitable. Flying with Indigo has mostly been a pleasure, and this was no exception. Professional as they are, there is still scope for improvement in certain areas like cabin upkeep, seat comfort and legroom (which however is offered at a premium). For frequent fliers, a rotation in the food menu would be most welcome. 
I would also like IndiGo to re-consider the practice of charging extra, over and above their usual fare, for window and aisle seats, which I had to pre-book to ensure that our group could sit together. This change will surely have a better impact on the ratings.
But on the whole, I would certainly recommend flying with Indigo.

title: On time, not very comfortable
text:
Friday 18th October and we were travelling onboard Indigo flight 6E 468 from Goa to Mumbai.

We were due to depart at 18.05 arriving at 19.35. A scheduled 1 hour 30 minute flight, however once on board we were informed that the flight time would be 50 minutes.

The aircraft pushed back from the stand early and was airborne a few minutes after the scheduled time, so virtually on time.

Leg room was no very generous knees touching seat pocket of the seat in front.

The seat was not very comfortable as there was a metal part running along the base of the seat, at the back, which pushed into the base of the spine.

About 15 minutes into the flight the crew commenced the sale of drinks and snacks.

Cabin crew were polite and efficient.

Punctuality was good, however, seat comfort and legroom was not the best and affected the overall rating of the review. 

The aircraft was an Airbus 320.

title: Cabin baggage scam
text:
A brilliantly orchestrated scam - moments before passengers board Indigo flight 6E 64 from Dubai to Mumbai , they weigh all cabin baggage including duty free items and tell passengers the limit is 10kg including laptop and duty free. It’s AED 60 ( approx. INR 1200 ) per kg beyond that. Be careful as they don’t mention it anywhere on your ticket or inform you at the check-in counter. Ask for written proof of prices and weight limitations before agreeing to pay as most passengers wouldn’t go through the hassle and rather pay to avoid further inconveniences. A large number of passengers were shocked, many coming from lower and middle class working backgrounds, looking to save money on ticket costs etc. myself included. I stood there and watched Indigo scam them all with these ridiculous charges that were thrown on them without prior information. It sickened me.

I would not wish such corporate thievery upon other passengers in the future. The airline staff is great, and my journey quite comfortable. But we are lost without ethical transactions and trust - and Indigo proved themselves to be untrustworthy. I would recommend Vistara airlines as a budget friendly alternative. text:
Recently flew the Delhi to Trichy route starting from Delhi at 2:55 pm to Chennai and with a one hour gap from Chennai to Trichy on an ATR.

The gap appeared less considering the challenges of seat location and the time for travel within airport and then luggage collection.

On top of it, the incoming flight from Vadodara to Delhi got late and therefore the flight from Delhi took off late. When local Indigo staff at gate was contacted if one should cancel the connecting flight or how would Indigo manage the changeover since the in between time had now been reduced to 30 minutes, the ground staff at Delhi seemed clueless. Never the less they were helpful and polite.

Similarly, when this predicament was told to the in flight cabin attendants, all they could tell, was they would inform the ground staff as soon as they landed. Hardly any comfort since this was the first time that one was trying a switchover of aircrafts in so less a time.

Take off was smooth and so was landing. Navratras had started, being the first day ; surprisingly NO sabuddana khichri as part of the in flight menu !

On landing at Chennai, the ground staff was over helpful and a separate bus had been arranged for the switch over passengers. However since all such switch over passengers had not bothered to ask the ground staff, some went the normal route on the bus going to the terminal.

Fortunately we were taken straight to the waiting ATR flight which we boarded well in time and the flight took off in time. Take off in the ATR was smooth but the landing was bumpy.

My issue in this long review is that when such good arrangements are in place for switch over of flights, why aren't all the Indigo personnel aware of the same. Why couldn't the cabin attendants if Del- Chennai flight not make an announcement for the same for ease of passengers. 

One less star for this reason

title: An arrogant airline which is supremely content to treat customers badly and callously
text:
There are two types of airline service providers— one which aims to be the best and preferred provider by means of quality of service; and the other which only aims to be the choice because their network happens to be the most extensive and passengers
have no choice except to fly them at least several times, even if they don't really want to.

It is abundantly clear that Indigo is obviously and arrogantly content to be in the latter category. They don’t care anything about customer service or experience.

We were a family of 6 passengers, including 2 children below 10 and 2 senior citizens. Our serious issue with Indigo was in Delhi. Airport Terminal 1, check in counter 9. We had carefully weighed all our bags prior to leaving for the airport, and had in fact, prepaid for 20kg excess baggage to avoid hassles at the airport. However, upon check in, the staff insisted that we were a further 7kg in excess, that is a total of 117kg (90kg free allowance plus 20kg prepaid plus an additional 7). There was no way this could be correct, we had weighed our bags repeatedly, and besides on our onward journey a few days back, the same bags were less than 105kg! 

We repeatedly requested that our bags be weighed in again as were sure the scale was wrong. We were treated curtly, with borderline rudeness by the check in staff who even started checking her mobile phone in between our conversation to ignore our request. There was a baggage handler standing right behind her, who also made no move to help. All it required was a couple of minutes to weigh our bags again in a nearby counter; we were shocked they didn't do this as we were well in time, we were at the counter 90 minutes before our flight departure time.

And once we landed in cochin and weighed our bags at the baggage service desk at Kochi airport, imagine our shock when the same bags showed 111kg-- 6 kg lower than what Delhi Indigo check in counter claimed. We were scammed for Rs 2400 by a selfish and callous airline, despite already paying 20kg excess baggage which covered our actual baggage check in weight!!

When we reported this matter to customer service desk of Indigo, their response was more of the same. Arrogant, entitled, making all kinds of excuses and basically proving they care zilch about genuine customer issues. 

Be careful about this airline, they scare only about their revenues and don't care about fleecing the customer at all. My advice would be to reach early, weight your bags before, and leave enough time to insist on bags being re weighed in an adjoining counter, if you suspect that they are trying to scam you.

Unfortunately, Indigo has such a network coverage that it is well nigh impossible to boycott them. But if there are comparable alternatives from Vistara, Spice Jet or even Go Air, choose them instead. Indigo and Air Asia are the worst when it comes to customer service issues. Even Air India is better than they are!!!

title: Worst Service Ever With IndiGo
text:
IndiGo is the worst airline ever.  Their app and online scheduling software sucks and their customer service is appallingly bad.
I spent two days trying to book a simple trip from Hyderabad to Mangalore via their online platform.  I was not able to do it my mobile phone because their app is poor.  Finally booked it on my laptop.  
Then some bug in their system messed up my info and my return flight got confirmed for the wrong date.  When I discovered the error and called the airline I encountered the utmost rudeness.   They refused to acknowledge their error, refused to correct it in a reasonable manner.  They spoke to me in the meanest and most unreasonable way.  They insisted on charging double to adjust the flight date.  It was crazy.  I got stuck paying this exorbitant rate because it was the only flight available at that time.  
Yet they refused to accept payment over the phone.  They said I had to pay online (which I was not willing to do cause I can’t trust their app) or at the airport, which I could not do cause you can’t enter Hyderabad airport without a boarding pass.  Ridiculous.  Finally they said they would make the reservation and I could pay at the time of my flight.  I have never witnessed any airline acting this shoddy.  
I didn’t want to fly on this horrible airline in the first place.  I flew with them from Tirupati to Hyderabad and it was awful.  The plane was uncomfortable, the engine was so loud my husband was covering his ears the whole flight.  There was no food and amenities on the plane were rudimentary.
Please do not give your business to these people.

title: Most horrible flight, poor Customer service
text: I recently took this flight - while booking my ticket I paid more money to get a more convenient time of departure (8:30 AM departure was around 2500 INR more than 6:30 AM flight).  However the Indigo Airlines cancelled the 8:30 AM flight and put me on 10:45 PM flight without notifying me by phone or email. I came to know about another friend who had also booked by the same flight and got text message. I would miss my connecting flights in rest of my travel by this change of flight from 8:30 AM to 10:45 PM. I called the Indigo Customer service to get the flight changed to 6:30 AM - which I avoided at the time of booking and paid more money to get some extra sleep. Indigo agreed to put me in the 6:30 AM flight, but didn't refund the extra money I paid. They argued with me that they are not charging me re-booking fees for this change. What is this nonsense?  They are the ones that cancelled my flight and put me in the night 10:45 PM flight. Now they are speaking about re-booking fees to me? First, the Customer Service phone number is not clearly listed in the Indigo Website. It went to some voicemail box. I somehow called after a lot of struggle and the Customer service agent was repeatedly saying the same things and made me tired. In the flight, I saw that the seat for which I had paid extra money (for the seat) had no reclining option. I paid extra for convenient time & got the time changed to a cheaper flight with no refund, paid extra for a better seat and got a non-reclining seat, again no compensation. I would certainly avoid this airlines.

title: Rescheduling of flight leading to missing the connecting flight.
text:
I had booked a flight from TRV to HBX via CNN. The TRV CNN flight was delayed by 2 hours and hence missed the next one of the same carrier. I understand there are some operational issues that can arise any time, in any field. But, what utterly shocked me is the response of the ground staff at the kannur airport who laughed and told me that the said flight had a before time departure since they knew my flight is going to be delayed. Now, the whole responsibility for the first flight being delayed lies with indigo. And the same indigo team, happily crafted a before time departure for the connecting flight even without having the courtesy to hold it for a matter of ten minutes. When I asked for this option, it was informed to me that the flight cannot be held at stake for a single passenger as it’ll cost them on the fuel charges. 
Now, the picture painted exhibits the fact the being the single passenger taking the connection flight is my mistake. The delay in the damn first flight by 2 hours is again my mistake. To top all this issues, I have to explain how unprofessional the ground staff at kannur was on informing me about a before time departure for my connection flight. 

Ps: it’ll be unfair if I do not mention about how cooperative and understanding the Trivandrum airport staff was. Mr. Harikrishnan, Mr. Rajat ( Duty manager) and Mr. Shine (Terminal Manager) stood by me, until I boarded the first flight and clearly explained to me the various choices and possibilities. I understand situations of this kind can arise anytime, but if the staff at Kannur were as understanding as the ones in Trivandrum were, I probably wouldn’t even have raised this issue. Being a doctor myself, I compromised on my evening visit to the hospital in Trivandrum to reach Hubli on time for another scheduled surgery by this flight with so much difficulty. But the end result was that I was stranded in the airport being helpless to both the ends. 

Being a common man, it makes me feel that if I was someone with more power and hold politically or financially, the said flight would definitely have waited the extra ten mins for my first flight. But alas, we do not get equal services.

title: Customer delight

About 45 minutes to destination the captain announce that there is turbulence and switched on the Fasten Seat Belt sign. The staff asked passengers to sit and not use the toilet which is the right thing to do but they themselves continued to service for food. 

When a flight is going through turbulent whether  how can flight attendants continue with service ?

The airline already has problems with safety due the Airbus - A320 neo engines and top of this the staff not following safety rules. 

The Government of  India has introduced new rules where passengers ar punished for violations of code of conduct - what about Punishment for Airline. 

I will not fly the airline again in the near future.

title: One of the worst international flight
text:
I traveled from Istanbul to Delhi on 7th August 2019 departing at 20:40 from Istanbul (flight number 6E12). The experience was the worst compared to the other flights we have taken. First, the airfare was in no way cheap, I booked a Turkish airline flight from Istanbul initially. But they changed it to the indigo flight. We thought it should be fine and agreed on the change. They arranged a totally inappropriate aircraft model (A321) for this journey. Sitting on the rock hard seats for more than 6 hours is torture itself but combined with incompetent indigo service made it intolerable. The airline staff  was not trained to provide services for such a long journey. They did not have enough food for all of us. Generally, an international carrier provides a full meal on flight. But instead, they provided inedible ready to cook meals for example noodles instantly made with warm water. It was in no way up to the mark. As it was not horrible enough, the staff was so slow to give us the bad food. I have no idea what took them so long to serve the food of that quality. Upon asking instead of taking responsibility they shrugged it off by saying that the airline is not hearing their request. What second-grade airline does not hear their own employees? The whole service took almost 3 hours to complete, when compared with other careers (for example tukish airlines) it gets completed in maximum 30 to 40 minutes. We were sitting in the middle and the food reached to us after 2 hours of waiting. Other airlines generally focus on the comfort of the passengers. In an overnight flight generally airlines switch off the lights as soon as possible. But indigo took at least 3 hours to switch off the lights.  It was horrible, we had no sleep the night before and we had a long journey ahead.  Moreover, since they were using a smaller aircraft, there was no in-flight entertainment.

Now coming to the other indigo services, we were not able to do online check-in. Due to some technical difficulties with partner airlines (turkish airlines) why do you have a collaboration when you can not manage the services. We were also not given the choice of meals while booking the flight. So we had to stay at merci of the airline staff for giving us the vegetarian food options. I called the indigo regarding the food choices but they demanded an extra 6 dollars for doing so, why do I pay extra while I paid a lot already. They might be operating successfully in the domestic sector but they are not capable of running an international operation like this. I have no idea if this will improve anything but I needed to vent it out and doing so. Be careful while you use indigo services.

title: If a picture could describe their service, it would be this one
text: Booked a direct flight from Jaipur to Kochi which changed to a layover at Hyderabad after booking. Boarded plane to kochi at Hyderabad (9:15pm) but the flight got cancelled because of flooding in Kochi. Since there was no organization by the airline there was a mob of desperate and angry passengers wanting refunds or transfers. My sister and I were ignored, we couldn’t get to the front desk because of all the men pushing and shoving (no attempt by the airline to mediate this), they kept asking the two of us to wait our turn and we patiently did. We wanted the next flight to kochi and after all that waiting they told us the next flight is fully booked, then we asked for bombay and they told us to wait so we waited till they said it was fully booked, then they asked us to wait more for god knows what (at this point we were the only 2 left). Then they said they could give us a flight to back to jaipur at 4:30 am via delhi (it was 12am at that time) but we needed to “wait”. I’m filled with more patience then an enlightened monk now. Then they forgot about us till we asked them about our tickets. Told us there’s no flight at 4:30am, it’s at 8pm. So now we were mad and we told them they don’t have a choice but to put us on the 4:30am flight. “Wait maam our systems aren’t working” we waited. “Ma’am our printer isn’t working so we can print your boarding pass so you’ll have to go to the ticketing counter and print it there”. I had tolerated enough of their miscommunication, lack of interest and poor organization. They made us wait so long in a place where there was barely anywhere to sit and even expect us to go print our boarding passes ourselves? At least send someone to get them for us?? My sister and I were at the Hyderabad airport for 9 hours. Oh and they didn’t even give us a meal on any of our flights from Hyderabad-del-jaipur. Also a lot of people from different flights were screaming at them about poor organization. So guess we weren’t the only ones.

title: Professional as always
text:
I travelled with my wife, sis-in-law and mom-in-law to Goa in June 2019. My Mom-in-law has to move around in wheelchair outside her house, but like our many previous trips, Indigo took care of her. Thanks to their excellent service, we have always been in the front of the queue, because of priority given to the specially abled.

The check-in was smooth, the boarding was smooth, the plane left on and before time, to and fro. The in-flight service was great. 

Indigo has ramp for climbing, instead of the conventional stairs, that other airlines have. So thats a big big incentive for us to travel in Indigo, as it makes the journey for my mom-in-law so much more smoother and comfortable.

The only thing that bothers me is that Indian flyers, by and large, do not care about flight rules and regulations. They tend to get up when the safety belt sign is on. On the Delhi-Goa sector, while landing, one or two passengers repeatedly got up to go to their fellow passengers, who were seated a few rows away, despite repeated requests from the crew. Finally the lead crew lady lost her cool upon landing, and severely reprimanded the errant passenger. And the guy had the indecency to not apologize, and instead say - Shut Up. In the West, the guy would probably have been arrested upon landing.

Its all the more evident when the aircraft lands...the moment the tyres touch the runway, you can hear the click of the seatbelts being opened, even as the plane is running in excess of 150 kph. And the passengers stupidly get up, even when the plane is on a slow roll, before it comes to a full stop.

Not Indigo's fault though. Happens with all the airlines in India.

Indigo is truly the best !!!

title: Pathetic customer service & non functional website & app
text:
I doubt Indigo will remain in the top slot in Indian commercial aviation, thier website is broken & their customer service is highly inefficient. 

I recently had the misfortune of flying Indigo. We were traveling with an infant (less than one year), and to save the time at the airport I did web check in ahead of time. I chose for auto assigned seats as the website wasnt showing me seats properly. The web check in was successful and I got a message saying that my boarding passes will be emailed to me. Everything looked great at this point. 

On the way to airport, I realized that Indigo still hadn't e-mailed the boarding passes, and I hadnt left enough time to go to the counter and wait through the long line, as I assumed my web check in was already done as per the broken website. I download their app, and that doesn't work well enough to explain what's going on. I then call up their customer care, and Mr Rahul N****r responds. The call lasted a whopping 40 minutes. And it was no use, he kept on putting me on hold to talk to the back end team, and gave me varying answers every single time. The incompetence and lack of responsibility was glaring. In the end, he ended up charging me for a seat incorrectly, but still did not issue me a boarding pass as he had earlier promised. I had to rush through the airport and run helter skelter with a small baby just to make the flight barely. 

I was very happy to realize that my return flight was not with Indigo and was with Go air. And in fact, thanks to Go air attendant, I got to know the actual reason why infants are asked to show up at the counter for age verification. Indigo website and customer rep were both ignorant of the reason.

In short, broken website, non functional Android app, highly incompetent and useless customer service. 

Not flying Indigo again.

title: Terminal Changes in New Delhi are a Damper!
text: Indigo flights into New Delhi, from Smaller cities in their network, land at the Indira Gandhi International Airport, but parking space allotments to the airline require them to have their passengers disembark at IGI's Terminal 2 (T2). Indigo flights to other cities, however, leave New Delhi from Terminal 1(T1). So if you're booked on Indigo, and are coming in from or going out to a relatively smaller city (say, Srinagar) and flying out/in to/from another bigger city via New Delhi, you have to change terminals. This is an unnecessary inconvenience, aggravated by the fact that the Delhi International Airport Co. Ltd.(DIAL) - which provides shuttles from T2 to T1 - does so in a way that leaves much to be desired, in terms of signage, convenience, fares, frequency, luggage space and the like! title: Flight cancelled at last minute
text:
This ordeal is related to the Indigo flight 6E 2023 for Bhopal to New Delhi which was scheduled on 4th July 2019. The departure time of the flight was 7:25 PM, however it was informed a day in advance that the flight was delayed and would depart by 8:10 PM. After reaching the airport, we were informed that the flight was further delayed and new ETD was 8:55 PM. All the while the ground staff had only one response that the flight will be here soon. It was further delayed to 9:45 PM. Finally we boarded around 10 PM and then after waiting inside the aircraft for another 25- 30 mins, the pilot informed us that his license had expired and he would not be able to fly this flight. By this time all the other flight options to Delhi had already flown out (Air India and Spicejet which have similar ETDs of around 8 PM or 9 PM from Bhopal.) Indigo didn't leave us any alternative to reach Delhi that night. Once all the customers alighted from the aircraft and assembled around the kiosk area of Indigo on the airport to figure out the alternatives, there were no senior members of the airline to deal with the customers and only confused junior members were present. There was total chaos and no one knew what was happening, few customers wanted their money back, few wanted Indigo to book an alternative for them at the earliest the next morning and some of us had an international flight later in the night which we couldn't take because of Indigo's mismanagement and miscommunication. We had to bear heavy losses as the international flights were non refundable and we had to book another flight in coming days to get to our destinations. 
I had tried to reach out to Indigo through various channels to get an explanation and refund of my losses and till July 9, only the flight amount for Indigo flight was refunded by the airline and no other explanation or response was provided. 
Really pathetic service and very poor management from Indigo.

title: Horrible!
text: I had a very bad experience with Indigo. I was travelling from Delhi to Tirupati via Hyderabad. I reached a bit late (5–10 mins) at Hyderabad airport boarding gate but the gate was still open. I asked them to let me go but they refused. The girl at the counter told me that she will adjust me in the next flight which is in 10 minutes. If I hurry and reach another gate on time, I can make the flight. I immediately ran towards the gate no. she told me. I kept asking around where that gate was but to my shock, when I reached there, I found that it was not a boarding gate but a check-in counter of Indigo. And I was not alone there; there were atleast 6–7 more people arguing with them for the same thing; they had all been refused to board the flight.  When I told the staff that I was asked to board the next flight, they told me that the flight has already left and there was no space in it; so it was anyways not possible to board it. That girl made a complete fool out of me just to get me off her back. They told me that only flight I can take is next day. As I saw no other option, I went to the booking counter to buy next days ticket. The girl on that counter refused saying they do not have any space in the next day’s flight. She told me that the girl at boarding gate entered in their system that I had reached the boarding gate 20–25 minutes late which was not true at all. She said that the only option I have is to take the next day’s flight ticket from another airline last minute paying in full and I had to do it. I also had to book a hotel to stay the night. This hit me back with a loss of around 20k. But it didn’t bother these people. The shock was that I was not alone. There were so many people facing the same harassment only by Indigo. While checking in at Delhi airport, I overheard the girl at the counter talking to the girl before me (who was a staff of Indigo). She requested her to give her the jump seat (extra leg room). The girl on the counter replied that the flight is already overbooked and they will have to refuse seat to anyone coming to check in after this. They will just tell them that they are late and so they will not get any seat. I think this is what is exactly going on here. They overbook the flights and then refuse admission to anyone who comes even slightly late (taking benefit of the fact that some people always get late) and then instead of apologizing for overbooking and repay for inconvenience; they harass them and make them suffer monetary and mentally.

But, as soon as the flight landed and came to a stand still, the ground staff became active and three queues were formed for different rows. The boarding process was prompt. We boarded the bus even when the the passengers from Mumbai were deplaning. By the time we were taken to the plane, it was ready for our boarding. So prompt are the ground staff. Secondly, the baggage limit for the KL to Delhi sector is only 20 kg per passenger - again a problem! The allowance should atleast be 25 kg, if not 30! Air Asia is another (very) low cost airline but compares much better in service and facilities both. If you buy their value pack, which comes to around INR 500, you get 40 kg allowance for 2 passengers (total) and a full hot meal for both passengers! Lastly, the boarding gate that Indigo has got to itself at KLIA (Gate L) is so bad that at night (even around 11.30 PM), you have no option to purchase food at all. There seems to be only one coffee shop at that Gate and that probably shuts by 11 PM or so! You will have to walk close to half a mile (15-20 minutes) to be able to get any food. title: Excellent piloting skills demonstrated at IndiGo airlines
text:
I took an IndiGo Airbus to Delhi from Mumbai very recently in the afternoon time while Mumbai was receiving intermittent showers. My going to Delhi was very important because I had to pick up some of my documents which needed to be submitted at my office. 

The flight was delayed and there was no intimation at all given by the ground staff. They were cool and just asked us to wait till they beckoned us to board. I waited with other co-passengers for half an hour. 

Finally we were called to get on to the company bus which was to take us to the flight on the airstrip. After the bus was fully occupied, it did not move for another nearly 30 min. I had no place to sit so stood all this while. After it got the green signal to move ahead it took us to the flight and there also kept us waiting for another 10-15 min till we were allowed to board the plane.

All went well after that. I was wondering what time it would finally take off and when would I finally land. But thanks to the pilot who apologized and explained the cause of the delay and further said he would speed up wherever possible and fly higher to make up for the delay to be on time. I did not believe him and thought he must be saying all this just to calm down the wary passengers. 

But to my utter wonder a flight of 2.15 hrs was completed in 1.45 hrs!!! That was the competency shown by the pilot. He endured a smooth landing to Delhi and my journey thus ended well.

On May 31, I reached the Delhi airport at around 6:00 AM and checked in at the emergency counter. I was having a total of 23Kg luggage. As I valued the time of other passengers, I  immediately agreed to pay. Hence as per the baggage policy, I paid 400*10Kg -4000Rs.

On arriving at Kochi airport after a 40-minute wait, I discovered that one of the luggage was lost and reported to the baggage claim representative. After waiting for more than 30 minutes, she cross-checked with the boarding pass and confirmed me that the bag of 10Kg is missing. For two weeks I have spoken to the indigo staffs numerous times and have absolutely no information for me as to the whereabouts of my luggage. On my continuous request, one of the senior officials of Indigo with whom I had a talk on June 9th confirmed that the bag weight is 10Kg and a refund of 3500INR will be given. I expressed a complete dissatisfaction as I paid 4000Rs extra for the same bag. The staff promised me that he will check with the finance department and revert back. But I haven't received any call yet.

I find it completely unprofessional how such a large airline like Indigo can lose luggage. I am missing items that are irreplaceable. text:
We just completed a marathon set of trips on Indigo--in RJA--HYD--CCU--IXB sector (a total of 22 person-segments). Six passengers were involved and four required wheel chair assistance. 

Except for one unfortunate incident of lost luggage (which they handled quite creditably in my view), the flights have all been smooth. The people working for this airline are quite professional, and were kind to the four wheel chair passengers. They seemed to be proud of working for the airline. On the whole, travel on IndiGO reminded me of travel on Southwest Airlines in USA--no frills but great on time service. 

About that lost luggage incident--due to some mixup an entire trolley of luggage was not loaded on the CCU--IXB (Bagdogra) flight and this included our six suitcases. This was quite problematic for us as we were going to stay in Gangtok--some six hours way--for our vacation.  While losing luggage is never fun, I appreciated the very professional and caring way they handled the issue. They rightaway agreed to have the luggage delivered to our hotel in Gangtok. They gave us periodic updates about the status of the luggage, and also gave us the contact number for the  car and driver  that carried the luggage to us the next day. Because they reduced the uncertainty about us getting our luggage, we were able to continue with our vacation (albeit with one set of clothes) secure in the knowledge that our luggage will come in a day.

 I would like to specifically mention two IXB staff members, Ms. Urbasi (who set up the lost luggage paperwork the  first day), and Ms. Jagriti (who kept us informed of the progress of luggage delivery).  

On the whole, I think I will stick to Indigo for all my India travel.

text:
Another experience which reiterates my view that in order to vie for the on-time record, Indigo is tending towards ignoring on customer satisfaction. The feeling one gets is that they indeed have dumped all efforts in delighting the customer but now are actually moving towards customer apathy. The recent suspension of services of Jet airways and consequent spurt in business is making Indigo arrogant. They "herded" all passengers on board early but the captain refused to switch on the AC. all of us were sweating profusely and were extremely uncomfortable and the cabin staff offered no explanation nor any apologies. The flight was ultimately delayed for reasons not shared and we had to bear the ordeal for close to an hour. 
Another case of lack of empowerment ( I pointed out one in my last review - and you would be amazed to note that my complaints and subsequent escalations with Indigo have fallen on deaf ears. The lone call which I elicited post many reminders was indeed filled with an unrelenting and argumentative and arrogant attitude of the agent). As per standard script they announced that passengers paying through mastercard shall get 20% discount on the in-flight food and beverages. I offered to pay by the same and was told that the machine wasn't working. I pointed out to them that then they shouldn't have either made the announcement or should stand by their word and give me the discount . Predictably I was treated with indifference.
My connecting flight was with a layover of only 55 minutes at Bengaluru. When we de-boarded at Bengaluru it was almost the take-off time for my connecting flight. Thankfully this time the weather had induced a delay for that flight as well but there was complete lack of hand holding by the ground staff. I had to run through the security and to the boarding gate and barely managed to catch the flight. They underlined the experience - the problems of Indigo passengers are indeed ONLY of the passengers and the airline shall NOT aid you ease the problem since the entire staff is too busy delivering the "ON TIME" performance.

text:
I had flown IndiGo several times on Indian domestic routes, and for short flights they are acceptable (i.e. just like any other budget airline in the world). However, recently they teamed up with Turkish Airlines (!) for flights Delhi-Istanbul (currently 9 hours, with a stopover in Doha), and that is truly a terrible experience!

Let's get this straight: Turkish have issues of their own (especially customer service, due to their poor English), but once onboard they are very smooth and pleasant: good leg space, good food, good entertainment. This has been consistent for many years, as I can attest after flying them on many intercontinental routes. 

It is therefore very disappointing that they would code-share on such a long flight with a poor airline like IndiGo, who offer basically NO service at all: very crammed seating, no blankets or pillows, no entertainment (forget individual screens, I'm talking about NO screens at all in the cabin), and ... this for food and drinks (see pic attached). 

I understand that if one books directly via IndiGo, this is the kind of sad flight one expects. However, I had booked this return flight via Turkish Airlines, paying not at all some discounted fee, and this is NOT OK. 

IndiGo is apparently planning to expand further into Europe. Do yourself a favor and don't fly them!

title: Good flight in spite of the aged Aircraft
text:
Pluses : Cheapest on time service. 
Convenient flight schedule 
Minuses:Aged aircraft,poor seat upholstery 
Flight time: 3 hours 50 minutes
AircraftType: Airbus 320
Class Travelled: Economy, Seat 2C
Price paid : INR 23500 return
Seating Configuration: 3+3
I am travelling this Morning, 9th May 2019, from Singapore to Kolkata by INDIGO Airways flight 6E 42 .The scheduled departure was at  02.45 hours from Changi T2 and I reached airport at 12.15. Following is my overall experience about the flight ( Rating given out of 5, 5 being the highest):-
A. Check-in: Checking at Row 7 was smooth and fast irrespective of 15 minutes system issue (Rating 4).
B. Lounge access: Since I was flying Economy , there was no lounge facility offered. I used my Priority Pass to access Airport Lounge.(Rating Neutral)
C. Boarding and departure: Boarding opened at 02.00 at Gate F35. Push back happened  at  02.30 hours and it took off on time at 02.45 hours(Rating 4.75). 
D. Seats and interior: The aircraft was an worn out tired Airbus 320 and looked needing refurbishment immediately. Floor carpet was faded and came off at points, seat upholstery got flattened due to overuse. Quiet uncomfortable for a 4 hour night flight. Seating layout was 3x3x3 in the cabin. My booked seat was 2C, an aisle seat in the front that allows quick access to toilet. Seat pitch was reasonable. Seat recline was ok. The seat offered satisfactory leg room. The inflight shopping offers limited selection of personal accessories, time wear collection and wine and spirits to meet your last minute shopping.The cabin was clean.(Rating 3.75).
E. In flight services: Being no frill flight, food needs to be bought. I didn't need food in the wee hours of early morning and I dislike cold food offered at Indigo. (Rating Neutral)
F. Cabin Crew: The cabin crew in charge inside the cabin were extremely polite , efficient and helpful. (Rate 4)
G. Arrival and baggage: Flying time was approx 4 hours .Flight landed at NSC Bose International before scheduled arrival at 04.10 am and gates were opened at 04.15 am. First baggage on the belt 13 came at 04.35 hours. (Rating 4.75)
H.Overall flight experience and suggested area of improvement: Barring old aircraft with flat uncomfortable upholstery ( which influenced my rating negatively), overall flying experience was good and surely value for money.
On the whole, it was a descent experience and definitely convenient and value for money. (Overall Rating 4).

title: They Are Fast!
text:
We travelled from Raipur to Mumbai by Indigo recently. We had taken the evening flight. It was a non-stop operation. Both of us are senior citizens. We had availed the senior citizen option for the second time while travelling by Indigo. They had verified our documents during the previous flight when we travelled from Mumbai to Raipur. But, this time too I could not print my Boarding Pass at home. I had to get it issued at the counter, I had to produce the documents at the check-in counter again to prove that we are senior citizens. This could be avoided in repeat cases.
They had not indicated the gate number during check-in. We were told that it would be announced later. Boarding was delayed a little bit. But, they were fast, The flight was delayed by few minutes. However, boarding was completed and the aeroplane was ready to take off in time. Take off was delayed by about 20 minutes, may be because another flight was to land. But, we landed in Mumbai well in time, rather before the scheduled arrival time. This means the airlines keeps leeway while making the schedules!
In flight service was good and prompt. This time, we were carrying our own food. So, we did not order for any food. We enjoyed dhokla we had got from Utkal at Bhilai and home-made poda-pittha, a special item Odias are very fond of!
We did not get Ola which we normally take at Mumbai. The waiting time was half an hour. So, the lady at the counter advised me to take pre-paid taxi. There was a long queue there. So, we booked a Meru. Though the man at the counter told me that it would take 20 minutes, it was available in 5 minutes. 
The driver was a nice person. We enjoyed the whole trip.

title: Bad Customer Support
text:
Our flights with Indigo were the worst we have ever had. First we had a flight to Bagdogra but unfortunately my baggage was in a security control. But instead of making a call, we were told at the end of the boarding, approximately 15 minutes prior departure that my bag was caught and we would have to get to a gate 5 minutes from the boarding gate. Arriving there, nobody really seems to care about it no matter who we talked to. Ca. 10 minutes later I was told to go in an extra room in where I should explain everything I had in my baggage. Hence we missed our flight but the Inigo airport staff member told us that we would, of course get new tickets for free since there was no fault made by us. Later, as we tried to get new tickets, we were charged with 2000 Rs "compensational fee" which is ridiculous since we had nothing to compensate as we made nothing wrong so far. Other staff members then told us that it is not rightfully to charge us in that case but it was too late to reclaim so we tried to reclaim online. Online we were told that we have no right to demand these fees because we already accepted it which does not sound like an argument but it was their main reason of why I should have no right to reclaim. At that point they stopped writing us. At the flight back to Delhi my baggage was demolished but we at least noticed as we arrived at the hostel. The next day we went back to the airport and claimed our demolished baggage but we were told that customer related contact   e.g.  refundings only work via online customer support. But the customer staff at the airport said he noticed my claim and case at the airport. With a bad feeling I, again, tried to reach the customer support but they said that I would have no right to claim demolished baggage online. And unpolitely asked me if I would have read the terms and conditions which I had and were it says that the conditions are based on the Montreal Convention which means I had 7 days to inform them about it. I, then, pointed out that I have contacted someone at the airport who noticed my case. After that they again said I should read the terms and conditions and that someone of that name would not "exist" and that there was not raised any claim.
Later they mentioned many more false suggestions like that my baggage was not checked in and so on though I had any proofs against those suggestions they just replied repetitively with empty phrases or just stopped the contact.
I think if you do not have an unfortunate case, Indigo might be a great budget Airline but if you do, you can forget about getting any help.

title: Useless app-worse customer service; paid service not provided
text:
Been flying this sector the past few months and have chosen IndiGo due to schedule and cost.  Flying experience while generally efficient is not memorable. Seats are uncomfortable, and on-board service is inconsistent;flight attendants do their best to ignore you, unless you press the call button. 

What’s been significantly sub-par for me has been the App experience and lack of follow-through by the airline, coupled with denial of certain paid services. The App is useless as it uses OTP for authorization, OTP never arrives on US mobile - used to at the beginning. Contacting CS via chat was useless too and they referred to CS via email. Writing to CS via email resulted in a nonsensical response with no relevance to the question! So App remains quite non-functional for me...no resolution as I have been given the run-around!

Finally, despite having paid for Prime services, including priority bag arrival, my bag arrived last in BLR! What did I pay for? The other bug-bear is that the airline is filled with folks whose life centers around Delhi and/or other parts of North India. This means that you are persona non-grata, if you don’t know Hindi (which I do). When I contacted CS in BLR, I was asked to speak in Hindi as the staff at the other end was proficient in only that language! What an atrocious situation for an airline that has global aspirations. The superior attitude displayed by staff against non-Delhi/non-North India passengers is irritating to say the least!

Overall, a so-so airline that fails to deliver on several fronts.

title: I haven't even stepped foot on the plane and service is bad
text:
I haven’t even boarded the plane and my experience with IndiGo Airlines has been terrible.

First, when booking via Google Flights, during the transfer to IndiGo’s sight and the selected flight itinerary the site automatically recognized I was from the United States and changed the departure date on my one-way ticket to a day ahead of my selected date. I caught it seconds after I hit send submitting my payment despite reviewing the information before paying. 

The way I confirmed what happened was when I was booking my next one-way ticket. I followed the steps from Google Flights to being redirected to IndiGo’s website and the date automatically changed before my eyes from the one I selected to a day before my actual flight.

I immediately contacted customer service, which was very difficult to find at first, via email and phone.

The repeated response from the IndiGo agents whenever I communicated with them was it wasn’t a technical error. It was my error. They all repeat it like robots verbally and in email. They never diverge from it and acknowledge the customer that it’s a problem. All I can think is that the airline is making bank when this happens so who cares? Right? Since IndiGo is the biggest low-cost carrier in India, they can do what they want and not change it. SCAM.

Blaming the customer simply doesn’t fly. It is a glitch in the computer system that the airline is taking full advantage. How about fix your system so it doesn’t change the customer’s selected date when booking from third party flight search engines? At the very least, acknowledge the customer’s issue and offer to help fix it. If the airline is aware of the issue, offer to correct the flight date without any charge. That would be the right thing to do if it isn’t corrected technically. Customers should not be charged for computer generated errors. That is technically the airline’s error.

Work-around: Look up flights you want in Google Flights, but open up IndiGo in another tab and book directly on the airline’s website. This way your flight departure date won’t automatically be changed.

Next issue: Flexi Fare is a SCAM! Sure, you can change your flight all you want, but you will be charged a change fee. The agent will start out saying its not a change fee, it’s the cost of the difference in the new flight. The cavate is you haven’t even booked the new flight and the fee is the same $12 as the fee you were just quoted for the other flight change request … so, how can that fee be the cost difference of the new flight and not a change fee? Why did I pay for that Flexi Fare fee to have this freedom to change my flight as often as I want up to 24-hours before the flight takes off? I’ll say it again, SCAM!

This is my first experience with IndiGo while organizing my press trip to India. Needless to say, with United Airlines cancelling my flight due to Pakistan shutting down its air space therefore causing me to have to change my domestic flights in India, no sympathy and no offer to help.

Right now, I’m so frustrated with this experience along with a whole string of other experiences putting this press trip together, I’m not feeling welcomed by India or Indians. It makes me believe that India doesn’t want Westerners visiting and experiencing “Incredible India.”

However, ever the optimist, I’m holding out hope someone in India will change my experience because my Indian friends in America all want me to have a good experience and write good things about their country.

Regarding IndiGo, it’s still the least expensive airline with the cleanest and uncomplicated (for the most part) website. Begrudgingly, I will most likely rebook my domestic flights within India with the airline, but now not without a chip on my shoulder that is getting larger with each encounter.

title: Too Clinical! Have lost customer touch!
text:
I booked a passage from Vadodara to Lucknow on 25th February. Knowing the habit of Indigo in causing absolute rush in its quest to be on-time, I booked  highly convenient flights. I would have reached delhi at 1750. providing for a terminal change at delhi i would have been ready to board the flight around 1820. the onwards flight to lucknow was at 2150, a good three and half hours early. 
The first glitch happened while checking in the luggage at vadodara. Indigo systems were down and hence the staff informed me that i will have to check out my luggage at delhi and re-check in the same. to avoid this i waited until the last moment for the systems to start functioning, but to no avail.
Due to bad weather at delhi, our flight was diverted to jaipur and we landed at delhi around 21:05. It was heartening to note that my onward flight also was delayed by an hour and would fly at 2250.
The baggage took a lot of time and I took the shuttle bus at 2140. I received a call from Indigo staff and I confirmed that i am flying on the lucknow flight. However when I reached the check in counter at 2210 they expressed inability to accommodate me on the flight.
I pointed out to them that someone had called me and that person was possibly waiting for me to reach the boarding gate. They made me call him again, spoke to him and then reconfirmed their inabilty to accommodate me on that flight.
It is pertinent to note that the flight hadn't yet departed.
What followed was an utterly forgettable experience where they made me shunt from pillar to post and finally told me that they would make me fly on an early morning (535 a.m) flight. I requested a hotel stay but they were visibly not empowered to take that decision. After much prodding they offered to give me lounge access. Since I frequent lounges, I pointed out to them that the lounge access would be for limited hours and NOT entire night. They expressed ignorance and indifference in that order.
I had to spend the night in a not so comfortable chair, all due to insensitivity of the airline staff. Were their systems functioning at vadodara, i would not have had to wait at delhi for checking out my luggage and I would have made it half an hour earlier.
All in all, a completely customer insensitive approach by INDIGO. and this is NOT the first time. Anyone can observe that in their quest to be on-time, they compromise on all tenets of customer service.

title: Stay away if you are a senior citizen..they treat you bad..
text:
I booked roundtrip tickets for my parents and also paid for emergency row seats (row 13) to and from Chennai. All information about them regarding their age was provided at the time of booking. However the check in agent at Trivandrum would not issue their boarding passes with those seats stating they were too old to sit there and that it was indigo's policy and that she could not do anything about it. They tried in vain for 15 mins to convince her stating that they had traveled in emergency row seats previously without any issues. And that both of them are in good health. She declined to help and did not  issue  a refund either stating she could not do anything as the tickets were booked online. On their return trip from Chennai, there were no issues and the agent issued them their tickets with the exit row seats. In checking indigo's policy on age for the exit row seats - I only see a min 15 age requirement and that the individual needs to be able bodied. Both of parents meet those criteria.
So today (March 17th, 2019)  I got a call from the customer service center - his response

#1. We have taken the feedback and will make sure this does not happen again (well..thats good to know!!)
#2. Senior citizens cannot sit in the exit row (for the return he claims they did not know the DOB of the passengers (seriously?) - it was a round trip ticket and I didn't have to enter the DOB twice. If thats their lame response to why they were given the emergency seats - did the second agent violate Indigo's policies or did they miss to check their ID's properly?? I would think that if that is their policy they should've switched them out of these seats (for both legs of the trip). Bw, I checked everywhere on their website to see if there is such a policy (I have not been able to locate it). 
#3 There is no refund on the seat fares since they had prime and got all the other benefits - priority check-in, meal and beverage (btw, I told him they did not get their beverages). As to the missing beverage he states "thats hard to prove" I will need to see the boarding pass then? Huh? You think I would make things up for a dollar soda? They paid for it and DID NOT get it. PERIOD.  

Indigo has stooped to such low levels of customer service - while the fares are low and the add on services are not very expensive, I wouldn't have cared for them to return a couple hundred rupees (which would be less than a few dollars) but its the lame justification and the "I'm informing you" statement he made 5 times that really made me upset. And above all showing no consideration for senior passengers and taking zero responsibility in this situation (it almost sounded like it was my parents fault for being that age and they should know better). Indigo may claim to be one of the best carriers in India but they sure are no where in customer service compared to any international carrier. Ahem! Enough said..

title: Good on time Service
text:
I am travelling this evening, 12th Mar 2019, from Delhi to Kolkata i on Indigo flight 6E615. The scheduled departure  was at 20.25 and I reached airport T1 at 18.30. Following is my overall experience about the flight ( Rating given out of 5, 5 being the highest):-

B. Lounge access: I was flying economy and hence there was no lounge faculty offered. I used my Mastercard to access airport lounge.(Rating Neutral)
C. Boarding and departure: Flight was on time. Scheduled departure was at 20.25. Boarding opened at 19.49 at Gate 8B by bus. Boarding process was smooth and fast. Push back was at 20.20 and we took off at 20.25 (Rating 5). 
D. Seats and interior: The aircraft was an Airbus A320 neo series and looked new and well maintained. The interior in Light Beige and Blue looked bright and well lit. Seats upholstered in blue gives. My selected seat was 22D, an aisle seat from the rear. Seat pitch was comfortable legspace was ok for a 2 hours flight. Seat recline was about 110 degree.(Rating 4.5).
E. In flight Service: Being no frill flight, there was hardly any in flight service offered. Food can be bought at the flight. I have a dislike for cold meal sold by Indigo. (Rating 4).
F. Arrival and baggage: Flight landed at 22.15. Gates were opened at 22.15 Luggage at Belt 2 arrived at 22.35 (Rating 4)
G.Overall flight experience and suggested area of improvement : Overall flying experience was good. Staff was well groomed and polite.(OVERALL RATING 4.75)

title: Why can’t we have airlines like this in the UK?
text:
This flight sequence was via Hyderabad. I also flew a few days later directly from Delhi back to Goa. Check in at Goa not brilliant. Luggage is sealed by security prior to check in meaning there is no possibility of redistribution. Two of our party of 8 being charged excess baggage even though we were on a group ticket and the luggage of the 8 was within allowance. I am sorry it is my job was the reply- polite but assertive. This will be pursued later. This was the only fault - albeit a big one- throughout the 3 flights.
 All flights extremely punctual. If it said 3pm boarding, it was that time on the dot. The departures were timed similarly to the minute- the start of pushback.
 Cabin crew all young females. I am not comfortable with badges labelled ‘girl power’ but this may be cultural.  All were very smart and welcoming- far more so than the fake welcomes that are a part of flying in the west. I felt they were very well trained as well- this did not stop one rightly holding her own big time when a tour leader insisted on looking after his charges when the seat belt sign was clearly fastened - good for her. 
 Unbeknown to me a meal had been booked for me and they insisted I took this even though I had already catered for myself. Very friendly but also insistent. I don’t drink alcohol when I am flying but I think the flights were dry - perhaps it is time European ones were too. 
 Hindi and English were the 2 languages- the latter faultless on all flights. At the outset they introduced themselves and also the languages they spoke- again far more than in the west even allowing for the many Indian languages. 
 Flights were on very modern equipment- Hyderabad to Jaipur was on a 320 neo. Better leg room than I am used to though not  lavish. All flights smooth comfortable and on time. 
 Apart from the luggage issue - the only  reason this was not a 5 star rating- nothing to criticise.
