A day earlier many flights were delayed or cancelled due to bad weather. This particular flight was also delayed, and so was the connecting flight.

I informed the air hostess and asked her if she could check about our chances of making it. After about an hour, she said that we would be boarding our connecting flight. The flight landed just 15 minutes before scheduled departure of the connecting flight. The air hostess said the flight too was delayed. The airline app however should departure on time. We were asked to take the bus to arrival and go to departure gate through the security. We rushed but the gate was closed. The gate attendants checked with their supervisor. Clearly, we had missed the connecting flight!
To cut the long story short, we were then given seats in the next morning flight, refreshments at the airport and hotel room for overnight stay.

To be fair, I cannot blame the airline for the delay. My main grouse is about the wrong hope given to us by the flight attendants. That’s my reason for giving a rating of 7. All throughout the staff was very cooperative, despite the fact that they were overworked due to the previous day’s flight delays.

title: No POP (Point of Contact) in case of delayas
text:
Traveling from Pune to Delhi, on 13th of May 2018. A storm ragged through the entire Northern India and both Pune and Delhi were hit!
I expected a delay of my my flight  6E  402 scheduled at 8.30 pm. It was rescheduled to 9.15 pm then to 10.30 pm then to 11.30 pm then 12.10 am, 1.25 am and 2.05 am, 2.15 am and finally 2.25 am which did take off finally at 3.00 am. 
The entire time Google was ahead with change of timings than the Indigo Staff. 
Around 2 am we finally tried to connect to someone from IndiGo Airlines for information at the airport but no had answers or were available for help.
We call the Airlines call center, they didn't know if the flight will take off the evening. They were ready to reschedule us on the next day 11.45 am fight back to Delhi. They did not have any earlier flights than this one. If we would had taken this option we would have had to spend the night and morning till 12 pm next day at the Pune Airport. (That would be almost 19 hours at the airport)!!
Finally, at 2.15 am the boards flashed 'BOARDING' and everyone gathered at the gates and the entire notification vanished from the board. The was unable to answer even then if we would be flying. 
The Airlines is supposed to provide food in case of flight delay. We as they serve the regular sandwich for 200 Rupees in the airplane, they will only provide you a dry papad and cold vegetable rice at about 1.30 am in the morning.

More information and support from Ground staff would had been appreciated.

title: Excellent Service.
text:
Check-In was very efficient, received my boarding pass quickly. 1hr to departure, got to know that the flight was delayed. Reason being, incoming aircraft was delayed at Mumbai airport due to congestion. I do understand this is not the airline's fault. Recognizing the delay, IndiGo provided snack boxes to all passengers.

Following a 2 hr delay, boarding was very efficient. The seats were quite comfortable, legroom tight. (Please note: this was an unusually long flight for HYD-DXB at 4 hrs 15 mins flight time due to strong headwinds. Usually its is 3 hrs 30 mins)

Would have to appreciate the crew though as, the entire flight, every 5-10 minutes they would bring cups of water into the cabin and hand it over to passengers who needed it.

Also, as there were crying babies on board, the cabin crew invited the mothers with babies to the aft galley during their break and engaged in conversation and offered any help. This was a nice gesture.

Landed into dubai, following which bags were out quickly. I have flown all Indian airlines many times from India to Middle East and, have to say, Indigo will definitely be my preference over full service airlines in future to Middle East.

title: A comfortable flight to Bangalore from Indore.
text:
Me and my friend reported at the Indore Airport and got checked in without any problem or much waiting. We were heading to Bangalore Airport and luckily got the middle and aisle 6th row seats. The pleasantries were good and the behaviour of the Crew was also good. This is something special about the Indigo that they have somewhat new planes and the good dresses of their staffs with a Tirchhi Indigo Topi. Indigo represents colour and the colour in Indian mythology is dedicated to god Saturn. This is as per my shallow knowledge of Indian scriptures. 
We occupied our seats after putting our hand bags in the overhead lockers which were almost full.
The take off was good and the flight was also comfortable. Since we had not opted for any special services, so we were not bothered about the minor turbulence. Since I was travelling with my friend so I did not find time to go through the Inflight reading material. The Indore Airport was not that big, but because the city has been awarded the cleanest city of the country, so we could feel the change there.
When we smoothly landed at the Bangalore Airport, we found it as one of the best Airports with all the facilities necessary for an air journey. Since, we had some arrangements at the Airport, so we were received well and headed towards one of the lounges where we enjoyed hot cups of coffee and rested for a while. Then we were to leave for Pune, so we were escorted to the security and then the boarding gate. Because of these facilities the change of flight was also very comfortable. Thanks to the staffs of Indigo there at the Airport. 
We found the Airline staff courteous and helpful. The check in, waiting and boarding were comfortable. I think Indigo is not a bad choice in spite of a mis-happening with one of the senior citizens last year. Our journey was comfortable. Thanks to the Airline.
I wish good luck to the Airline.

title: Very comfortable
text:
This flight was scheduled to leave Indira Gandhi International Airport (Terminal 1) at 11.55 but was delayed by ten minutes because the plane was being cleaned. Despite the delay in takeoff, however, the flight arrived in Hyderabad right on time. 

A good clean cabin (and surprisingly adequate leg space). My ticket had been booked in such a way that it included a meal coupon. This doesn’t mean, though, that I got a specially prepared meal: the difference was that I could choose whatever I wanted from the menu on offer (instant noodles, sandwiches, tea, coffee, juices, etc) and not have to pay for it. I chose a chicken tikka sandwich but since that was unavailable, had to settle for a jungle chicken sandwich instead. With that, I opted for a masala chai. 

The jungle chicken sandwich—chicken, mayo, a scattering of what looked like parsley—was good, the bread soft, the filling creamy and fresh.  I would have liked this even better if it the filling had offered some sort of textural contrast: some chopped celery, some nuts, something to make it more interesting. The tea, which I had expected to have perhaps cinnamon and cardamom, was instead dominated by cloves. At first taste, I was taken aback, but this turned out to be far better than I would have thought: in fact, very good tea indeed.

title: IndiGo vs Air Asia
text:
I was recently in Bangalore on company business and managed to take a few days’ vacation and take a side trip to Goa with my 14 year daughter who accompanied me on this trip. In Bangalore we stayed at the most amazing Leela’s Palace and in Goa at the equally most amazing Longuinhos beach resort. Both places have their own uniqueness and I had written trip advisor reviews for each.

The concierge at the Leela palace was kind enough to arrange my entire flight and hotel booking for me via booking com. I had never booked a flight this way before and he set up my account in minutes and (based on my work schedule) arranged my one hour, each way, flight for me. Since it was just a one hour flight I figured that nothing would matter. But depending on which airline you book with – IT MATTERS A LOT !

My flight to Goa was with Indigo and my flight back was with Air Asia. It was just the way it worked out because we had to work around my work schedule. We carried with us simple back packs, really cabin baggage because it was a 4 night stay and left our main luggage at the Leela palace hotel .
 
Air Indigo seems to be the bigger airline and offered machine check in with some other airlines listed (vs an agent ticket counter). It was effortless and the machines were conveniently located just outside the main terminal building.

We got our boarding passes and tags quickly and passed through the first security line into the airport itself. BTW move down and along from the entrance point it is 100% less crowded as everyone seems to go in via the main drop off point.

We had a bit of a shock at security when they separated us into lines for males and lines for females (had not experienced that before coming from North America). This separation is not where you can “see” your loved one, but more very far apart. I had to try and locate my daughter once I cleared security and they emptied all of her stuff taking out our bug spray, tiny baby scissors, batteries and anything they found to be “dangerous” water bottle included, but I digress

We got on the flight with absolutely no regard for weight since this was a self-serve type set up and we had no baggage that we were checking in. the flight crew were exceptional. Coming from North America , and both on my way into India as well as on this flight, 

I saw how incredible difficult Indian passengers are, really spoiled beyond belief. They will buzz for a flight attendant, non stop for water, food, etc even while the flight attendant is serving passengers ! They don't say "please" or 'thank you" just "water" (if that's what they want lol. the guy in front of me actually called for a flight attendant to get him his cabin baggage - as soon as the plane landed in Goa and before it came to a full stop. She actually did as he asked when the plane came to a stop.

Our North American flight attendants would not last a single flight there. In North America, if you here the flight attendant call, it usually follows the pilot or flight attendant announcement and if you even LOOK at a North American flight attendant the wrong way or make them work - you will pay or even get kicked off the flight. This is how service is since 9-11 and sadly they take full advantage of it
The flight attendants actually managed to serve everyone with a hot drink and snack in that short 1 hour flight

Not realizing the difference between Indigo and Air Asia, on our return back to Bangalore we had to check in with an agent at the counter because we could not find any self serve check-in. . Air Asia have no machine check-in they are too small to make it with the big boys.. Worse they informed us that we could not take our (over 7 lbs) back packs into the cabin with us as we did with Indigo (without any weight restriction).
We had to check our bags in because they (no surprise) exceeded the 7 lb limit! 

Their service on the plane for the 1 hr flight was just average while Indigo was superb and Indigo make an effort to get you some refreshments in spite of the short trip

We wasted so much time waiting for our bags at the other end, thanks to their ridicules policy of 7lb limit for in cabin baggage. 7 lbs is a purse and its contents !

I make it a point never to argue with front line staff who don’t determine policies but the agent actually had the nerve to ask me to speak to her supervisor who was nearby to pass on what she believed to be “super service”, because of my politeness, not even realizing how inconvenient this was for us and how silly their policy is for simple back packs. Who are actually taking LESS LOAD overall by not checking in heavy baggage in the cargo hold. I am aware that there's a difference but please have some consideration.

Don’t fly the smaller airlines when travelling – fly the bigger ones, they are less bureaucratic and give you more for your buck! IndiGo were great and I highly recommend them.

title: Keep low expectations & have a great flight!
text:
A few years ago, there came a time when a previously unheard name -'Deccan Airlines' shook up the Indian aviation industry with it's rock bottom fares. Just like the airline's name, the fares were completely unheard of. In quick succession, a number of competitors cropped up and the term'budget airlines' made a big time boom. Flight tickets hit an all-time low, sometimes touching three-digit fares too. That brought about a change in the aircrafts as well. They had to introduce something cheaper than economy class - and thus introduced the'cattle-class' aircrafts which offered very little in terms of passenger conveniences. The junta didn't complain - they got to fly at fares which sometimes turned out to be lower than a 2AC ticket between the same cities. All was well, India was shining.

But all good things come to an end. Many of these airlines went on a loss-making spiral and disappeared. Those who survived, such as Indigo and GoAir to name a few, jacked up their fares significantly. So what remained were the cattle-class aircrafts with a'polished' ground staff and fares which remained somewhere between the 3k-10k mark. Among all these airlines, Indigo emerged as a strong player, primarily owing to its punctual service and it's fleet of brand-new and well maintained aircrafts. Indigo stuck to it's base formulas for success and still remains among the top domestic airlines in India today.

As I have already mentioned before - the aircrafts in Indigo's fleet are all new and well maintained which is a reassuring feeling for flyers. I have travelled in an old Boing 737 from Deccan's leased fleet and I know how it unnerving it feels when the aircraft makes rattling sounds. Thankfully, Indigo's fleet of A320s do not make you feel so, even in bad weather. The interiors of the aircrafts are also very clean and well maintained. However, what mars your journey is the comfort, rather the lack of it. In the most polite words, it's just as comfortable as a state transport bus. You get the same amount of leg room and shoulder room. The seat can be reclined, which is actually funny - I wonder why they allowed the seat to recline by just three degrees? Was it supposed to be a cruel joke on passengers? On all other aspects - lumbar support, back support, and lateral support, it's just as comfortable as the abovesaid state transport bus. New definition for Air Bus?

Comfort aside, the service is actually quite commendable. Maintaining a 90% punctuality rate in a country like India is a herculean achievement and Indigo have consistently maintained that record - which itself is the prime reason why I prefer Indigo even when I get cheaper options available. The ground staff is actually quite good if you keep yuor expectations low. If you are travelling light(i.e only cabin baggage), you can actually carry your web checkin slip and proceed directly to the security gates - a straight saving of 30 minutes. On-board services are best avoided. For a three-hours-or-less journey, it's not worth paying the obscene amounts charged for food and conveniences. The food itself is nothing worth writing about, though on worst cases of hunger pangs I may pick up a tin of cashews. Nothing more.

Overall very satisfied with Indigo's fleet of well maintained aircrafts and punctual service. Never expected more from them and hence I was never disappointed.

title: Indigo airlines. No frills Rip off
text:
Flight date 07th April 2018 2045 hrs

I checked in two hrs earlier. At the check in I was one kilo over baggage allowance. I was asked to pay as I was informed that they had "zero excess baggage tolerance".
However I had web checked in earlier. I had paid Rs 800 for a seat which was first row as the airline claimed larger leg room for this seat, 

At the duty free I did some shopping.

Boarding gate was at the end of the terminal so a long walk.  Indigo probably opts for these gates as they may incur lesser airport charges.

At the boarding gate hand baggage was weighed again.  This was including my laptop bag+one tote+ the duty free shopping bags( never seen in my entire life duty free purchases being weighed by any airline, or for that matter hand baggage being checked at boarding gate for weight.  I am a frequent flier since the last 35 years & flown most airlines).  This is my first review for a airline and comes from total frustration and disgust with this carrier. I was asked to pay for 8 kilos.

On board:
Pathetic in flight service.  Cabin crew was missing from the galley most of the time.  They were in the aft galley with the others gossiping. Their meal services lasted 10 mins as hardly anyone purchased the snacks/drinks as they were priced very high. When I asked the crew for a second glass of water she queried" anything else"(tone suggested dont disturb us).

On board menu as below

PRINGLES $2
BANANA CHIPS $2
COOKIES $2
SUGAR FREE COOKIES $3
CASHEW $3
SMOKED ALMONDS $3
BANANA CAKE $ 3

PANEER TIKKA SANDWICH $5

CUP NOODLES $5 (HOW RIDICULOUS CAN IT GET!!!)
CHICKEN JUNGLEE OR TIKKA SANDWICH $6
BLACK LABEL WHISKY 50ML $7

SO A VERY LIMITED BASIC MENU

I paid $23 for my drinks and meal.  No change available for a $100 or $50 note.
So be prepared to pay by credit card.

IN FLIGHT ENTERTAINMENT: NONE

The two seats next to me were empty.  But the first row the arm rests do not go up.  So one cant use the next seats to spread out.  I saw passengers in the rows behind doing that I I wondered why I had paid Rs 800 extra for 6 inches of extra legroom.

LANDING:
The pilot landed halfway down the runway.  Where runway 270 is intersected by the 2nd runway and applied full thrust/brakes to stop before he came to the end.  De accleration rate much more than normal throwing some loose objects back.  WHERE IS FLIGHT SAFETY INDIGO???

For the flight I spent:

Excess baggage at checking in bags: Rs 1900
Seat 1C extra payment: Rs 800
Extra baggage at boarding gate: Rs 8500
Flt Ticket: Rs 5600
Meals/drinks on board:  Rs 1500
Total: Rs 18300

NO frills airline fare which seems good at Rs 5600 gets hiked to Rs 18300.
For that amount I could have travelled business class on any reputed airline!!

WAY TO GO INDIGO!!!  WITH THIS KIND OF SERVICE YOUR DAYS ARE NUMBERED!!!

title: Changing Terminals in New Delhi is a Pain!
text:
I was flying Indigo Airlines from Pune, India to Srinagar India, via New Delhi on March 31, along with my aged parents. We arrived in New Delhi's Terminal 1 (T1) from Pune, and knew that since March 25, 2018, flights with numbers from 2000 through 2999 would take off from Terminal 2 (T2). To catch our flight to Srinagar, we had hoped to get onto a comfortable Airport Shuttle, but we were horrified when - after a wait of 15 minutes or so - a DTC bus was identified as our Shuttle! It was a pain to carry my infirm Dad on board, since there was no ramp on the bus, and so his wheelchair was not put on board. This large red bus then dropped us at T3 ( not T2) and we had to find another bus - after another 17 minute wait - that would take us to T2!
As a regular Indigo flyer I least expected this shabby arrangement. The Indigo staff were helpful but seemed to suggest that all the problems were on account of GMR the operator for DIAL. I disagree. Indigo too has a responsibility!

title: Difference between good and great
text:
Indigo Airline of India is a good airline. It's network is wide, its schedules are reliable, it focuses on operating on time, the aircraft are clean and the crew are professional (some warmth has waned). A good airline nonetheless. 

Are they great? And by what yardstick do you measure that? 

The yardstick I use is how does an airline or any service provider handle a service failure. 

My checked baggage was damaged during my recent flight on Indigo; one wheel and the wheel assembly was missing and the shell was cracked. 

I approached the Indigo baggage counter at the BOM domestic terminal in the arrival hall. It was being manned by three ladies. All ignored me. They were talking to each other. There was no one else at the counter.

Common sense and good service sense should have prompted them that only passengers with baggage problems will approach that counter and it would an opportunity to convert a passenger into a lifer!

Instead they ignored me until I asked if one of them would like to attend to me. They were pleasant after that. 

I was offered a compensation of Indian rupee equivalent of $38 because I was leaving for Singapore in 2 days. There was no time for the airline to try and repair it by then. 

I said I will not be able to replace the damaged bag in Singapore for $38. It was them raised to the equivalent of $58 for the same reason.

I refused and was given the e-mail address to the airline's customer service. 

I wrote to the customer service department. 

After a few e-mail exchanges I decided not to pursue the matter after the airline offered me maximum compensation under the Conditions of Carriage (CoC).

Technically the airline is right. But the offer based on the CoC is insufficient for me to buy a bag in Singapore. It may be sufficient to buy one in Mumbai.

It refused to understand that all I wanted was to replace my bag which it damaged. 

What was required was a discretionary decision which it proved itself incapable of making. 

Consequently Indigo is a good airline but it has some ways to go before it becomes a great one. 

I think it can and it will. It has the good DNA for it. I wish Indigo well.

In this case, in an obsession for taking off in time, they were in a hurry to embark the passengers. No sooner did the last passenger of previous flight disembarked, the passengers for this flight were asked to board. 
This way, the plane also does not get time to cool down or get all the technical checks done, which is essential before a flight.  
I think, this way, the airline compromises on the safety of the plane and all its passengers and crew.
Safety is more important than “being on time”.

title: Good Flights staff needs more professionalism
text: I had a flight from Bangkok to New Delhi. Best thing is they depart on time. title: On time - no hassle
text:
On arrival at the airport we were met with a long queue for the security scan of checked in baggage.  Then we noticed this was for a rival airline and the IndiGo facility had no queue.  Check in was done very efficiently and the seating in the departure lounge was extensive and very comfortable.

title: Nice flight
text: The aircraft crew as very helpful as we were travelling with infants. They helped us while handling the babies. The plane is maintained very neat. title: Problems with IndiGo

title: Excellent Airline

title: Professional Budget Airlines
text: A good professional Airlines with known on time performance. Most of the services are good and hassle free. Only issue is seat allotment if you want do web check in which they try to earn money and sometimes uncomfortable.

title: Rude Cabin Crew - Poor Meal Selection - Couldn't Care Less Attitude

title: Stuffy, Cramped Seats
text:
Cramped seat with hardly any legroom made this short flight from Goa to Mumbai a hell. I had paid extra for supposedly extra leg room in row 11, aisle seat. The Mumbai Goa aircraft was  not too bad.  This sector [GOI-BOM] was a disaster. I pulled my muscle in the thigh in the bargain, trying to make myself comfortable.Aircraft was clean, the staff professional. title: I am frequent flier with Indigo
text: Indigo is my preferred Airline of Travel. However, the cost is very unpredictable.  Some times it is competitive and most of the other times its costly than Spicejet which is my next preferred airline.

title: Small things will make a difference
text:
The airline serves no food , and one my buy it , at exorbitant rates; this is common amongst all national airlines today.  So other little things count when you travel. At Ahmedabad, we were taken by bus to where the aircraft was parked. In Mumbai, we were similarly taken by a bus from where the aircraft was parked  to the arrival lounge. 
In Mumbai particularly, the first step into the bus was at a very high level. I wear a very visible lumbar belt, am a senior citizen, and I had problems climbing on. At one point the effort was excrutiatingly painful, and I just stepped back on the ground. Then someone unfolded some kind of step that allowed one to roll up the luggage into the bus, and I managed to go up on that , with assistance.  

You know, even buses that travel intercity, have a small stool they place on the ground to enable folks like me to climb in.  It does not take some brilliant MBA type to pay attention to passenger needs  here. A simple stool could have been used, or a kind of sideboard thing, you see on larger jeeps and stuff, a halfway thing before you climb in. There was no Indigo person when we disembarked and climbed a few steps into the arrival hall. A very kind foreigner passenger young woman, simply held out her hand to help me as I got down from the bus and climbed a few steps into the hall and I was very grateful for that.  

Why cant Indigo pay attention to small things ?  I have some stuff to say about the announcements of flights at the gate in Ahmedabad prior to departure. But will leave that for another time.

title: Excellent airlines
text: Indigo airlines is the best airlines in domestic sector. Always on time and very good staff at check in counters and at boarding gate. The cabin crew is just too good and always ready to help. You can't compare this airline as it is the best

title: Impressive budget airline
text:
I'm a frequent flyer on the Kolkata - Hyderabad route and use Indigo a lot for my travel purposes. Keeping in mind that Indigo is a budget airline, their services are impressive than many other low-cost carriers across the world. I have following pros of this airline in mind:
1. Indigo mostly uses A320/A321/A319 in their fleet which are usually clean and comfortable, however, a bit more legroom would have been better.
2. The air hostesses are trained and professional. As in any other Indian airlines, you will get free drinking water on-board, in cups.
3. The Indigo flights are often punctual with occasional delays which mostly because of reasons that are out of their control.
4. You can select your seat, free of cost, for most the seats.

title: Economy class is the worst & Irregular timings
text: Gave 2 stars for the following reasons - Price which is usually lower than other airlines and flights availability at peak times. That was the only plus of Indigo. Their economy class one of the worst, even when compared to spicejet. Legroom and seats are congested. I recommend not to travel in Indigo's economy when you are travelling with an infant or kid below 2 yrs. It was from my wife's experience recently, she got the worst service and the flight got delayed by 2 hours 35 min. I waited at Hyderabad airport for the whole time because they delayed the flight after passengers boarded in. Without even taking off, they insisted on switching off the mobiles. My wife planned for a 2 hour journey and packed food required for that journey and because of the delay my kid had no proper food for 4 hours (it was a 6:30 PM flight but reached hyderabad at 11:00 PM). The attendants were rude and they did not even support, not atleast a bottle of milk to buy. And also because of late check-in they did not even provide a seat for my kid which I actually paid for. Additionally, they charged 400 INR/kg for extra luggage, just for an additional 950gm or so, I then regretted for not sending my luggage through some courier company like bluedart or gati or safe express. . I felt cheated and never in my life, my family will fly by Indigo.

title: Lucknow- Bangalore flight
text:

text: I am flying today 28th Feb'18 to Bengaluru pn Indigo flight 6E875 departing at 17.15 from Kolkata. My ticket was bought by my client and I selected seat 13D an aisle seat. title: On time; efficient baggage service
text:
The flight taxied off and landed on time or maybe few minutes before time. Also by the time the passengers disembarked, the baggage was on the conveyor belt. So, it is possible to be out of the airport even with check-in baggage collection within 20 minutes or so. This is commendable. Cleaning process is quick and neat.
My rating is average in terms of web check-in process, seat selection, seat comfort, legroom (even for a petite person like me). In the last few rows, selection should be allowed for 'no charge' during web check-in at least within the 24 to 48-hour before journey window.

title: Be Ready to Face Your Drill Sergeant All Over Again
text:
Traveling Indigo reminds me of encountering the drill sergeant at 5 AM roster call. Terrifying! Each time you "tighten" your Op, discovering the new "rule" is nerve wracking. 

I am early adopter of Indigo when it was NEW. For sheer efficiency, at a time when I used to prefer “just in time” flying! Some recent RULE changes that had me sprinting: 1. No printouts at kiosk less than an hour before flight Q up! Even if you have NO baggage to check in. 2. Gates will close slightly earlier (now 25 minutes; am waiting for 30 soon);  you can get into trouble for  ANYTHING at Indigo.  It is TENSE. 

I have decided: if time is not a factor, avoid Indigo. When time is a factor i will fly indigo. I have changed. Due to traffic conditions in most Indian cities I now mostly take flight times  which are late at night. So timing is ACTUALLY - never a problem for me. 

When I travel with family and kids DEFINITELY no Indigo. On holiday? No Indigo. Want to relax? No Indigo. You cannot be shepherding the lot through every hoop that indigo has set up all the way to your destination.

Today i was over the 15 kg weight limit by 2 kilos. The Lady Said: next time pack within 15. I said: I tried ... you know how it is! Lady: next time pack within 15. I said: I am carrying only a laptop case... She said: I am saying next time carry only 15 kilos. NEXT TIME. (Slightly raised voice). 

We sods dont provoke Indigo staff.(Not after that Mumbai video). Once again reminded of my NCC sergeant who would ask if food was good again and again till we said "YES SIR!" , I meekly said Yes, ma'am.

Then she said: the flight is late by half an hour. I wanted to say: OK! But next time be on time... But then she might change her mind about those 2 kg she let off. "Yes Ma'am" I said meekly.

title: Internal Flight @ the Butt Crack of Dawn

The security check in process however is a time consuming process. Suggest you leave an hour in your planning for this part or you'll miss your flight. The flight itself was relatively pleasant. My friend and I slept most of the journey and arrived at Indira Ghandi airport a tad more awake than at the start of the journey.

title: Not refunded
text:
I was supposed to have flight from Mumbai to Indore in November and I booked my ticket with my Azerbaijani bank card. After a day it was written that we can not recognize your bank account, so we canceled your ticket, but will fully refund. I contacted with their customer services multiple times, and they promised to refund amount in a week. More than three months passed, but I havent get any single penny from this airline. 
Be careful while booking your ticket. Use Indian bank account, otherwise do not rely on your booking, because after a day most probably you will get an email that you ticket was canceled and your money will be stolen.

My particular flight was delayed by about 30 minutes, but the ground personnel kept us informed and updated. Very nice indeed! I will certainly fly with IndiGo again! Make sure to check out their inflight magazine, which I thought was nicely designed and beautifully illustrated, I fly a lot so that an airline magazine catches my eye is actually an “event!” I hope the airline keeps its service standards and grows its network in the future.

title: Direct flight to Amritsar
text: My Husband and I, took a return flight from Bangalore to Amritsar in January 2018. While booking the tickets we got a direct flight from Bangalore to Amritsar but return was with a stop over at Delhi.  Just 2-3 hours prior to check in at Amritsar Airport, we got a call from Indigo and they told us they have put us on a direct flight to Bangalore, instead of the stop over at Delhi. We would reach Bangalore at the same time as our original flight and hence we were fine with the change. When we were checking in our baggage and collecting our boarding passes we had to tell the attendant about the change and he knowing the fact that we were travelling together gave us seats which were not next to each other and did not even have the courtesy to ask us about the seat preference. We assumed the seats will be together and we found out only when we had to board the flight that our seats were not together, even though the seat next to me was empty, the attendant had allotted a seat somewhere else for my husband! Being in a service industry I would have expected the attendant to be a little more polite and ask us our seat preference or atleast inform us that he has allotted seats in different places to us and if we are fine with it. We have never faced such carelessness in our airlines.

title: Disown their responsibility
text:
You expect a airline to care for the passengers first, placing customer service at the forefront. We see from this airline, that it is all about money generation from passengers. 

here is the experience in detail. On 6 Jan 2018 we were booked into 6E 246 to New Delhi. We had checked in and were having lunch at restaurant near the boarding gate. We never saw any notice of the flight boarding or anybody reaching out to us saying that the flight is boarding and if you don't board now you will miss your flight. 

Instead, when we reached the gate, we were told that the flight has left. When we mentioned that we never saw any notice the flight was boarding, they said we tried calling you but since you had an international number, we could not reach you. They also said an SMS was sent. But we neither received an SMS or a call. 

Then the person at boarding gate said you cannot board this flight but maybe we can get you in the next flight. please go to the ticket counter. When we return back to the ticket counter, the staff without any care or concern, say you have to pay another Rs 27,000 to get into the next flight. When we raised the issue of no notice of boarding, again the same thing was repeated. We tried calling you, but could not because you had an international number. We messaged you. But we showed no message or call was received.

They then summoned the manager, who is happy to refund the price we paid for the last ticket, but still wanted the balance of Rs 19,000+ for giving us ticket to this flight. 

A very very poor service indeed. If we have an option,we will never fly by this airline again.

title: Reliable service with budget price
text:
This airline does not provide free meals but gives the opportunity to buy snacks at a reasonable price. They also give the opportunity to pay a slight bit extra for a seat with more legroom. I have had numerous flights with IndiGo and all have been on time and no luggage was lost.
They have another special feature. To enter and exit the plane, instead of steep metal steps to climb up, they have introduced an articulated ramp with gradual slope and good non-slip surface. This is excellent for anyone, but wheel chairs and baby strollers can just proceed easily.

title: Poor Experience in return flight
text:
While I had a great opinion about Indigo in my onward flight from Bangalore to Mumbai, my return flight journey was pathetic.

Ground Staff:  None of them were helpful.  An indigo person could not even tell me which gate the flight would be.  He just asked me to check the board.  The board was so bad that it was flashing continuously between timings and hindi and english, and not able to read it properly.

Flight was 15 minutes late and i came to know about it only when i was in airport, NO sms message was given.  Interestingly it became 45 minutes late in the end.

Boarding was pathetic as ground stafff did not control anyone and there was rush in the coach.  No coach attendants were standing near the vehicle (there was one person who came in the end when the bus was full).

This experience at the Mumbai airport made me rethink about Indigo and average out their rating when compared to the pleasant experience i had in the Bangalore - Mumbai flight.

title: Good Airline with a good service at Bangalore
text:
Had flown in this airline recently.

Booking:  Booking was good through a different website.  
Cost:  Cheap flight with a very good offer to Mumbai.
Check In:  Did a web check in.  Not very happy with the web check in as it is not user friendly.  I did not find half the seats and could not locate how to navigate to that.  A big thumbs down for the User Interface for web check-in.
Airport:  Good service at the airport.  An Indigo person in the main hall quickly told me which gate to go for the flight.
Boarding:  A big thumbs up for the boarding.  It was done in a very systematic way.  Ground staff should be appreciated for the same.  Handling the passengers from boarding counter to the plane was very smooth and systematic.
In the Plane:  Seating was ok, crew was courteous.
Flight time taken was ok, on time travel.  Getting down at Mumbai was also smooth.

(I had a different experience in return flight, will mark in a separate review)

title: Port Blair to Mumbai Via Chennai
text: This was cheapest flight on the date to coming home from Port Blair to Mumbai, there was one stop at chennai for 2 hours. But flight service was great and cabin crew is very polite.

title: On time but they actually treat you like cattle
text:
I must have flown on IndiGo at least 50 times, for work as well as holidays. My only reason to travel on this airline is that its rarely late and for most metro cities in the country it has many a flight option. However, everything else about the airline is bad. Right from check-in to boarding the aircraft, the experience is that of traveling on some bus. They will box you into the bus, make you wait on the tarmac, on the stairs, herding people around impolitely to manage their own efficiency. The in-flight service is bad and even if you buys some food it is served as if they are doing you a favor. 

Its an airline where the efficiency comes at a cost (of being respectfully treated like a fee paying guest).

title: Good
text: Reasonable earthy fair. Fight travel was comfortable inspite of air pockets, all services were if required had to be paid extra except water. The flight departed on time. On arrival they had a passenger vehicle to commute within the airport.

title: Pathetic Airline
text: This is World' most worst airline.I lost my ticket money,the staff were rude and I suggest people to think twice before opting for their low prices.

title: My flight from Delhi to Chennai
text:
It was an average experience. I requested at least three times the Cabin Crew to show me the merchandise of an Electronic Slate, which I wanted to buy. They did neither brought that to me nor evinced any interest.
It was futile to pursue further.

title: On time flight
text: Nice flight for business travel. Have the option of corporate bookings for business travel. Mostly on time boarding & arrival.

title: Nice journey and good service
text: I traveled from New Delhi to Bangalore for  business purpose. Ticket price is less .   travelling in indigo is nice and comfortable . Service is very good compare to other flights. seating is comfortable. check in process is easy.

title: First time on Indigo!
text: It is a low-cost airline. They do not serve free food in-flight. You either buy or carry your own. Apart from the food, the airline was good for travel. On-time and comfortable. No complaints. They did show some leniency towards baggage. They did not go by the prescribed weight, which was customer friendly. We paid a small sum for Fast Forward which comes with quick check in and your baggage comes out first. I will fly with them again!

title: Good Flight & Punctual
text:

Leg room, seat comfort and value for money are very reasonable. Overall Its a Good Flight.

title: Nice legroom, comfortable journey!
text: It was afternoon flight at 4.10 pm from Chennai. Flight had good legroom, it was clean and looked like new aircraft. We had tea and cookies and service was great. Checking in was quick. Friendly staff. Journey was on time.

title: Nice Flight from Bengaluru To Kolkata
text: I traveled along with a friend from Bengaluru to Kolkata and the flight was on time. The seating was also very comfortable and we got the tickets for a very cheap price as we booked during their 11 th Anniversary offer. We did not face any issues and our journey was very comfortable.

title: Always on time!
text: we had flight at 5 pm from delhi, the flight took off at right time and landed at its scheduled time. I have never experienced delay while travelling with an Indigo. Though I believe they have a scope to improve the food menu which they serve onboard.

title: Ok for short international flights
text: My first ever use of a low-cost airline for an international flight. Was a bit apprehensive since Indigo has evidently been unable to scale up properly and has acquired the tag of being the worst ever airline in India. This manifested itself in extra long queues at Delhi airport for the domestic leg of the flight. The other issue was that one had to fortify oneself with chocolate bars if you had no intention of paying for the overpriced food at the airport and in the air since an international flight of 2 hours necessitated check in a good two hours beforehand. On the return leg, there was a comprehensive security check before entering the aircraft which almost seemed like an insult to Thai security check which itself was more comprehensive than security check in India. I'm not sure if this was unique to Indigo but I didn't see the same happening at the gates of other airlines.

title: Efficient Service!
text:
We took this airline while returning back from our holiday trip of Malaysia and Thailand. Overall experience was average till check-in however when we reached at boarding gate, there were some extra staff employed at the gate to stop the passengers for extra scrutiny of luggage. They removed a bottle of Vicks Vaporub from my baggage which was only half filled of the measurement mentioned on the bottle of 110 ml. Thankfully they didnt stopped from carrying water from the water dispenser placed outside of boarding gate. This is quiet pathetic experience that when the security staff at the entrance after check-in have checked and scanned entire baggage along with shoes and other stuff; why this kind of practice by the airline!!!

Also unlike others they have a practice of Indian culture being an Indian company and provides water to passengers without charging any hefty sum however if one still wish to buy a packaged water, they have an option to do so but no compulsion. 

Hence overall experience was good compared to previous travel experience on other airlines.

title: Simple but great positivity
text: It was a great experience with team indigo. They are very much punctual in timing. That is very important an liked me. Nobody in India value the time. But still they can improve with price management. Cost of flight is still high. As Vadodara has limited option, they o not reduce price. Hope they will take care of consumer.

title: Customer care personified!!
text: We were at the check-in counter with excess baggage with an hour to departure in an already full flight. after shuffling and reshuffling our baggage and things and seeing our worried faces, we were suggested to not board the flight and we were offered the flight for next morning. We took the option. Stay arrangements were made and everything taken care of with a big bright smile on their faces. assistance was provided in every sense and all manner. Special Mention of Ninan thomas and Mayen at the Cochin International Airport who helped us with everything. No wonder i m in love with Indigo Airlines and they have simple given me one more reason for continuing the patronage.Thank You. Go Indigo....Always!!

title: Don’t fly Indigo if you are an International traveler connecting to other Indian cities
text:
While I can’t fault the service, 2 stars for the conflicting and confusing information on baggage fees. So you are an international passenger landing in India with a 23kg allowance. Indigo allows 15 kg. But oh, you can pre-book extra luggage of upto 30 kg if you are an International traveler. But wait, that’s only if you are traveling internationally on an Indigo flight. And where does Indigo fly internationally - not to many places.... So, while the price is good and the service is decent, if you are connecting to other Indian cities from your port of entry, you are better off flying good ole Air India!
If you travel with only a cabin bag, or if you are taking short domestic flights, then by all means, Indigo away!

title: Best Airline in India
text: IndiGo is prompt, professional, and cost effective airline. We flew with IndiGo a couple more times during our time in India and they were always on top of things. The service is excellent and very accomodating.

title: Overall its good experience with the Airline
text:
As it was December last week all the direct flights from Pune to Dubai are either full or very costly. I choose to fly with Indigo from Pune to Hyderabad and Hyderabad to Dubai.
Flight was good except the transfer time at Hyderabad airport was  9 hrs. Even they gave me checkin bag at the airport. So I did not had any option to wait at airport with 30kg checkin bag and 7 kg cabin bag and a laptop bag. There is one makemytrip counter where you can keep luggage bag. Which is around 300 INR for first 2 hrs and then 40 rs for every hour. Thee is one other option to use dormitory run by government. There is shuttle bus every 10-15 min from Airport to that Airport dormitory. for 6 hrs they charge 200 INR. It is a good option for someone travelling alone to rest. They gave a bed in a shared dormitory. No locker facilities. Toilets are OK.  But all Indigo overall experience was good.
Whenever you book any International flight via any connecting domestic destination. Please make sure that you book from Indigo website than any other website like makemytrip. Because checkin baggage limit is different for domestic and International. May create a issue when u book connecting flight from other website than airline.

title: My return from Trivandrum
text: On my return journey, I felt cheated by airline staff. I had my ticket with complimentary food, but staff refused to serve and charged money for that. On repeated request, I was replied roughly that your ticket may have food to be given but my list does not have your name. Bad boarding announcement before boarding and very rough behaviour by ground staff at time of boarding. No preference to ladies with infant or to senior citizens.

title: Good Airline on timeliness
text: The flight boarding was on time but departure wasdelayed by 1/2 hour & reached Kolkata 1/2 hour late.The food availability on board was limited in variety & so is soft drinks.The cleanliness of the aircraft was good & grooming of the staff was average.The check in counter at Delhi airport was having long ques & the Fast Forward counter was only one & was taking  unduly long time. text: Service was good.  Flight was on time.  But it is not a budget airline any more.  For direct flights, the cost is extremely high as compared to hopping flights.

title: OnTime as ALWAYS
text: IndiGo, once again amazed me, its low fare on time policy wowed me and it was executed perfectly. The seat was comfortable and I was pleased. As it is a budget airline it is fair to complain that the food options are expensive.

title: Indigo

title: Punctuality is their strong point
text:
This flight was scheduled to depart at 8.40 AM, and (true to Indigo’s reputation for punctuality), the plane did start taxiing at the scheduled time. I appreciated that the co-pilot (who made most of the announcements and had a pleasantly clear and very audible voice) announced that we would taxi for 8 minutes or so and flying time was an expected 2 hours and 10 minutes. This was adhered to, so on that count—the punctuality—Indigo gets a thumbs up. 

On other aspects, not so much. For instance, the cabin crew came around announcing that they’d be serving food (which has to be paid for in cash unless you’ve already paid at the time of booking the ticket), thus waking up several of us who’d had to make an early start—I and my family had had to wake at 5 AM—and were trying to sleep a bit. Of course, food would be welcome and in other circumstances I wouldn’t have minded being woken up—except that the food trolley didn’t actually come around for another half hour, at least. Then, they were dispensing only food already ordered by some passengers.

Finally, when my father placed our order—two portions of poha and a coconut water—we were told that the poha was unavailable (I thought on a flight at about breakfast time—this departs at 8.50—making sure you had plenty of breakfast items aboard would’ve been important). We ended up having to settle for the cake: four thin slices of sponge, two of them being a marble chocolate and vanilla one, and the other two a banana cake. Both had the somewhat uniformly uninteresting texture of mass-produced cakes, but tasted okay. The marble cake was better than the banana one; the latter, while it had little threads of banana fibre visible in it, didn’t taste much of banana. 

Okay flight experience, but not memorable. The bus which drove us from the plane to the departure lounge had a large ball of bloodied face tissues lying near the end. Disgusting; I wish they’d check buses between loads of passengers and clean up as required.

title: Frostiest ground staff I've encountered with an Indian airline
text: FEEDBACK 6E 54, 07 March 17, Singapore to Chennai. I should have written in about this earlier but let it slide then. Yet recent events with Indigo have impelled me to bring this to notice now. I'm a regular Indigo flyer but that has come down a fair bit after a rather cold experience with their staff at Singapore-Changi on this particular flight. Sure, they were professional and efficient but utterly frosty and seemed disinterested in any sort of service with a smile, even when it came to returning them, since I always make it a point to greet all service staff I encounter. The lady at check-in was downright brusque, especially when it came to a small bit of excess baggage I had, mostly books. Also the staff at the payments desks. I've had better experiences with such is all I'm going to say. Staff at the gates at Changi were no better and seemed devoid of any warmth, too, or in proffering information. Sure, great to have an efficient airline but what's the damn point of being 'different' in the service industry if there are no polite greetings of any sort? I've pretty much made sure my family flies to Singapore and Dubai on other airlines and have mentioned this to several acquaintances (who've incidentally told me of similar experiences on these sectors with Indigo too). No point flying an Indian airline if there's no Indian warmth in the experience. Might as well try out foreign carriers because I don't really expect much in this regard when flying economy with those on these sectors. Indigo's hype about service needs to match what we encounter. I do like the airline and admire their efficiency but surly staff is the best way to drive away discerning customers, must say

title: Clean flight, well groomed and trained crew. Need more meal options.
text:
Clean, hygienic flight. Well-trained, well groomed, calm, warm and welcoming cabin crew, helpful towards the old age and disabled. On board meals and beverages need to have more variety. Only drawback is that it takes off and lands at most old domestic terminals, for instance in Mumbai and in Delhi. Most flights are on time, much more as compared to other carriers.

I do not like the idea of selling the first row seats for a premium price. First row seats should be reserved for old age people and disabled until the flight is otherwise completely occupied. Only then should the seats be allotted to remaining passengers on check-in. Just for a little money, it becomes a hassle for those who need assistance.

title: Cheap but not very cheerful
text:
Used this airline three times during our trip to India.  Check in is always a nightmare due to the fact that the staff always allow people to push in before the queue.  So before you have even got on the plane you are unhappy.

The seats are tiny and the choice of food is pretty poor.  It doesn't really matter when your flight is only an hour, but on a 4½ hr flight you get a bit hungry.

Descriptions of food are not good, they only name the dish.  If you are not a local, you have no idea what you are getting.  

I did ask a stewardess what was in something but her command of English did not stretch to understanding my question so I gave up.

By the third flight I went native and brought my own snacks to eat on the plane.

Bureaucracy is excessive all over India but showing my travel papers to about 20 people does get a bit jarring, especially when you have to show someone at the top of three steps and at the bottom.  Similarly at the entry to the check in queue, the end of the queue and of course at the desk.

By the time you actually get on the plane you wish you could just have your details stuck on your head so that you don't have to keep showing then to everyone.  I am pretty sure that one of the people who wanted to see my docs was a lavatory attendant :o)

title: Chennai-Pune flight - Some people good, some people cooperative
text: I had a flight on last 1st Dec from Chennai to Pune via Indigo airlines. I reached the airport and stood in Bag Xray machine and asked one of the member for Pune flight status . He said checkin is available and it will be done so not to panic. Though I had already done my webcheckin but i had to drop my checkin luggage. Then I followed all queues and reached the counter where the lady executive asked me to move to another counter . When i reached that referred counter, the male executive was busy with some other passenger and I quickly asked my query reg Pune flight - he said that checkin is closed 10 minutes before. He instead of calling and coordinating with staff kept doing stuff for other passengers which he could have put on hold so as to help me. My voice tone gone up and I started scolding him that he needs to help me rather then just checking status on system. Then a female staff who pitched in and understood all my concern and then she took an initiative to help me- and allowed me to board the flight with my checkin luggage (as its weight was just 6 kg but its dimensions were little big) She helped me in passing me all security gates and dropped me at the boarding gates. I was too overwhelmed and have thanked her numerous times..

title: If On Time performance is your thing
text:
This airline has grown rapidly to become India's largest, overtaking Jet Airways. Its motto seems to be on time performance, and they live up to achieving it most of the time. Their crew is well trained, their processes extremely well defined, whether it is boarding, checkin, or catering on board. ( All food must be bought, by the way, there is no free meal , at least in economy).

The aircraft are clean and the overall presentation smart. The only jarring note is that the airline code for this airline , and their flight magazine name, is Indigo 6E, ( like BA for British Airways ) and all announcements by the staff make this sound like Indigo Sexy. Intentional ?

The focus on turning around the aircraft is so strong, that things are done like automatons, rapid, efficient but lacking warmth. However, it works. The same goes for the on board trolley service, and the trolleys block the aisles for most of the flight even on a two and a half hour flight ! That is the main negative

I was also disappointed that a staff member at the airport could not explain a strange incident regarding my online check in experience, she merely kept spouting the same words like a recorded message without understanding what I was saying. Again the automaton strikes

Excellent connections to most of the country though, and a few international flights. I hope they start flying India London sectors soon

title: Quick and reasonable business flight
text: I am on a business trip, Italy to UAE to India, and this flight from Dubai to Delhi fit my schedule well. .    Leaving Dubai in the early evening, arriving Delhi late evening.    I believe i was likely the only non-India resident on the flight.     Flight was really good, and interesting.    Somewhat like being on a "bus".     Lots of kids, kids fighting, people moving around, lots of noise, etc, etc.     Getting on the flight the attendants were somewhat "herding cats" in trying to get every one to their seats.     No monitors at the seats, no movies, no wifi, no frills.    The flight attendants were trying to SELL stuff throughout the full flight, food and drink and duty free, etc, etc.     Interesting point, the prices were actually CHEAP and good!!    The seats were literally small, meaning very thin backs.   Width was OK, leg room was good.     There was only one class of seat, but i was in a seat with somewhat more leg room, exit row, but leg room in all seats seemed good.    The flight attendants were great, checkin was long, but was free of any problems.     Gate was good, boarding was good, and aircraft seemed to be new.   We were on time, no real issues.     Flight was about 3 hours, and i would probably not take this airline for more than a 4 hour flight, just not set up for LONG haul with this configuration.

title: Deteriorating on time performance.
text: I am returning from Mumbai to Kolkata  on my once fav domestic airline Indigo, which of late zI use on compulsion not by choice. I selected flight 6E 395 departing at 17.55. As I always do, I did my ticketing, check-in and boarding pass in the Indigo App, which is extremely user friendly. I pre booked seat 2D, by paying Rs 300, only to get out early knowong well fligjt will be delayed.I printed boardong pass using the checkin kiosk. No human interface. Great. Huh. Boarding was at 17.50 hours  as I was fearing, due to late arrival of incoming flight a common fact of Indigo and flight took off with a 40 minute delay. The aircraft was of a older Airbus A320  series. Interior was clean and seats were comfortable with 20 degree recline. I avoid Indigo on board food that are on sale and spend the flight time reading a James Joyce classic on my Kindle. Touch down was at 9 pm. To my annoyance there was total mismanagement at the ground level and it took almost 25 minutes from the aircraft to arrival hall. SAD REFLECTION . Reliable airline, good aircraft, but delayed arrival and abysmal ground staff at arrivak... hey guys at Indigo, tighten your belt fast. Else competition like Spice jet Will dethrone you.

title: For Indigo, customers hold no importance as only revenue matters to them.
text:
I am writing this review to share this information to the passengers (who travel by air), so that they can consider avoiding Indigo airlines so that they don't get cheated and harassed. To us, this was our worst customer experience.

My wife and I traveled on an Indigo flight (#894) from Delhi to Amritsar on 5 Dec 2017, post couple of days, we landed in Delhi from US. 

Per Baggage regulations, we knew we can check in only 15 Kg each for domestic leg, as we did not book Indigo flight along with our international flight. As there was no extra weighing scale on the T-1D, we weighed our checked in bags at the Indigo counter. Both the bags weighed around 18 and 19 Kg respectively. As we had our one of cabin bag almost empty, we requested that we shall put that additional 7 Kg of stuff in that.
Once we arranged that, then we were asked to weigh in our cabin bags along with check in Bags. It came out to be around 48 Kg for 4 bags. 
Then, to our surprise, we were asked to weigh in our laptop bags as well, seriously? This was the first time, we were asked to weigh in our laptop bags at any airline.
When I asked the Indigo staff member (Sumit Chauhan, emp id: 026869), if he/Indigo did this activity for all the passengers, to which he mentioned it is case to case basis.

I spoke to his manager (Rini Singh, emp id: 7491) and she was of no help at all. She forced us to check in one of the two cabin bags (around 12 Kg) while specifically saying that she is allowing us to take our laptop bags along with one cabin bag. The way she mentioned that was like she is doing us a huge favor by allowing our laptop bags along, which, I understand, anyhow always go under the seat if you have additional cabin bag.

She boasted that excess baggage fee is the source of revenue for the company and she can't let us go without paying for the same and customer experience/service does not matter at all. Now, for around 7 Kg of excess baggage earlier (for our check in bags), we were forced to pay for 12 Kg for our cabin bag. She went on to say that as the flight is full, she can't check in bag for free which was absolutely incorrect as the flight's occupancy was only around 65-70%. I clicked photos to support this just before take off. Indigo can also confirm this as they would have exact figures.

The things got even messier, as they charged us INR 3600 for 12 Kg as excess baggage fee whereas as per their website, we should have been charged much less. To us, this is a case of forgery as they cheated us by overcharging. Before filing a complain with the required department, I wanted to share my experience. Hope it helps.

title: Brilliant flight!
text:
Flew with Indigo for the first time in November for a very short but pleasant flight to New Delhi from Dubai! We took 6E 48 that left at around 5:20am! 

The plane was clean and the stewardess were all extremely welcoming and helpful! Drinks/food service was served straight after take off and was a good variety and well priced. We had seats in the row in front of the wing exit seats so we could not recline our seats but the were comfortable enough. Toilets were kept clean throughout the flight and even though boarding started late we still departed and arrived on time! The stewardess were so kind to us as we left asking about travels and complementing our looks (we are so pretty!!) which just shows they are interested in their passengers and made us feel welcomed in India.

We did however have some issues prior to flight departing with Indigo especially with check in and also the social media/customer service team on Twitter. Prior to the flight I was looking to contact Indigo to clarify the carry on baggage policy. There was no way on the website to submit a query or drop an email, only a phone number which I decided not to use as it would cost me a lot to call from the UAE to India. I decided to contact Indigo via Twitter as I find this method most helpful. The response time from Indigo was shocking took at least 4 days for them to get back to me and kept coming up with the excuse of "we are very busy and dealing with a lot of enquiries" - not the best start when my simple query could not be answered and a such a small airlines customer service team cannot handle a massive amount of queries, it needs to take example from the larger airlines. I also found it extremely strange that we were not able to check in online for an international flight which seems strange as other larger airlines is able to do this and would of saved me a long wait in the queue and also not having to report to the airport 4 hours before the flight departs. The other problem we had was at check in. We had all our documents, flight inteirary etc printed off ready to hand over but I was asked during check in for the credit card I had paid the flights with. I explained to the person on the staff counter that my credit card that I paid with was lost and I had ordered a new one and surly if the name under the booking, the passport holders name and the credit card holders name all matched up and I was also able to provide the first/last four digits of the card it would sufficent enough (surly this happens a lot especially wtih people travelling). After a lot humming and moaning he finally managed to sort it out and our carry on lugaggae was checked. However I did notice that even though we complied with the carry on lugaggae procedure of 1 carry on case and 1 duty free bag accumlating to 7KG a lot of other passengers had more than the allowance and were not questioned on this or asked to either check it in or discard it. I find that very unfair especially to the people that do follow the rules and this has been to brought to Indigos Airport Services teams. 

Other than my two small greivances the flight was brillaint and I would 100% fly again with Indigo and recommend the airline to friends and family.

title: Deteriorating quickly!!
text:
There was a time when Indigo was my favorite airline in India. They were on time, well organized, clean, fun just different from the other full service airlines. 

After a string of bad experience, I can't say the same anymore. Our most recent trip from Visakhapatnam to Hyderabad was final nail in the coffin. Problems started while boarding. 

- Not sure why but didn't board via an aerobridge even when one was available
- Boarding was haphazard. Passengers towards the back of the plane were entering from the front and vice-versa. You can imagine the confusion inside!!
- Our row of seats were wet and dirty. The puke bags were full and not cleaned out. Lucky for us, another empty and good row was available for us to be seated
- The icing on the cake, was when I made a complaint to Indigo they responded with a nonchalant attitude and shifted the blame to me. They say, I should have raised the issues with the ground staff to be able to be addressed effective. The fact is that I've already raised the issue with the ground staff and they just ignored me

To someone who has flown millions of miles in and outside of India, these were not 
 isolated incidents. I've had issues (boarding, noise, seat comfort etc) on other flights but at least the other airlines have been willing to listen to feedback and ensure such incidents don't happen again. But no sir, not with INDIGO. The new and cool kid on the block is too focused on turning the aircraft around and avoid delays. A commendable effort but shouldn't be done at the expense of inconvenience to your passengers. Loyalty is the name of the game in travel industry.

I sincerely hope someone in top echelons of Indigo is listening. My days of flying Indigo are over.

title: The most professional domestic airline in the world
text:
These guys know their business and executes it in a professional manner. Their on time performance no one can beat. The on board crew are well trained and does their job efficiently. 

Recently after my surgery I needed the wheelchair service. I was amazed at the way they took care of me from the airport gate to the aircraft and after landing to the exit gate totally free of cost. My hats off to them. Abroad you would have to pay a high price for this service.

What more can I say about them. Their aircrafts are new and modern. The aircraft inside is super clean and their on board announcements are crisp and clear. 

They are also very caring and totally customer focused. After my recent surgery I had to cancel mine and my wife’s tickets. On bringing it to their notice they refunded the full ticket cost to me. No other airline would do that I’m sure. 

There are a dozen reason why I frequently fly Indigo but must of all their lowest and competitive fares. 

A couple of things they can do to help customers further are to reduce their cancellation fee and improve their on board food menu. More variety coupled with more hot food. Further, the convenience fee of Rs. 200 per person per sector is too high. 

Carry on Indigo, India loves you.

title: Cheap and Good
text: Most of the time you can find best rare for this flight. 95% on time or before time. Inside the flight - Leg Room is okay. But for people 6 feet tall i would say to opt for emergency seat for greater leg room but its payable. Also first rows upto to middle is payable. Food is served on board on cash / card basis. I would recommend to use Dollars to purchase or AED - United Arab Emirates Dirham as no other currency would be accepted if flying from UAE. Under no circumstance on International Flights INR - Indian Rupees would be accepted. Also their currency conversation is horrible so please take some dollars with you. Sandwiches are @ 5 $ and going down. Three type of alcoholic drinks you can purchase. Johnny walker Black, Bacardi, White Rum, Absolute Vodka miniature bottles. All 5 $ each or maximum 6 $. Maximum allowable hand baggage is 7 kg with a limit to 10 kg. Anything beyond that would be chargeable on the boarding area with no exception. So be careful. This includes Duty Free goods purchased. Over all crew are courteous. And finally dont be late for your flight as their moto is on time, So counter and check-in closes on time with out any fail. title: Solid on time performance
text:

The baggage check-in can be a bit smoother, especially for those who already has a boarding pass via web check-in. Airline should add more baggage drop only counters.

The courteous staff and tasty snacks (paid off-course, its a no frills airline after all) was great experience.

The best part about the plane was seating, which gives less thigh support but more leg-room. This feature is subjective and can be debated but I found it comfortable.

The man-handling of a passenger incident recently has been in the news, but incidents like these are one-off IMO. Now a days all of us are ready to fly off the hook at all times. But the situations could have been managed in a better way by airline staff.

Overall it was a good short flight experience and I surely recommend Indigo airlines' domestic operation.

title: Clockwork precision!
text: I had to travel on multiple urgent personal (round) trips through last couple of months. Short notice bookings and crunched travel times were the norm. Timings were so tight that even an hour of delay was commercially and objectively expensive. title: When customer isn't important anymore
text:
While Indigo has been in the news lately for all the wrong reasons, I have another story to add. First of all, while they promise on time arrival, among other fake promises, that has barely been the case here. Having heard about a family emergency, I rushed to the Bangalore airport for a flight back to Delhi. As there were none available at that time, I tried my luck at the Indigo counter at the airport. They had only 1 flight available at 12:00 noon, according to which I would reach at 6:00 PM. After trying other flight carriers and trying my luck on travel websites, I found a ticket via Hyderabad which would make me reach Delhi at 2:10 PM. This flight still didn't show on their PCs at the counter. Therefore, I went ahead and booked the ticket for a whopping 25k Rs as I needed to be in Delhi as soon as possible. While I reached Hyderabad on time, the "best" part of the journey was yet to come.

Upon reaching the Hyderabad airport we were informed that the flight was at 12:20 PM now, with a delay of 40 minutes as the flight had arrived late from Delhi due to smog reasons. That was understandable at that time because we all heard about it in the news. What wasn't understandable though, was that they would keep using this excuse throughout the day and keep ignoring the 180 passengers they had booked to take to Delhi. At around 12:20 PM, another surprise came, and we got messages about a further delay in departure to 2:50 PM. This was further delayed to 3:20 PM. Within this time, they didn't even have the courtesy to offer us refreshments of any kind. While I know that they aren't supposed to provide us with any, but then they are supposed to make us reach in time (their main marketing communication message). Upon insistence from several passengers, they did provide us with a meagre quantity of rice and raita meal. While that happened, they delighted us with another delay of 1 hour, thus shifting the departure time to 4:20 PM. This was when all hell broke loose. We asked for their manager to come, who took his own merry time (almost 30 minutes) to come. Only then did we realise, that the aircraft which had to come from Delhi had already come, but it had some problem. Therefore, they had to arrange for some other aircraft from Mumbai, which got delayed too as it couldn't get ATC clearance. While that was another white lie, as there was already a Mumbai to Bangalore scheduled flight set to reach Bangalore at 3:55, they barely did anything to arrange one for us. It was just convenient for them to wait (and make the 180 of us wait). While the 4:20 PM flight did take off (at 4:40 of course) the in flight announcements from the pilots was again a huge confusion. As per their announcement, all that 4.5 hours delay was because the flight arrived late from Delhi. It's surprising now as to how the pilots weren't told of the exact reason for the delay, but for all the customers (God in terms of service marketing), the reasons for delay kept changing every hour. As expected, there was a further delay of 1 hour in landing because of congestion due to smog, and we ultimately landed at 8:00 PM. Ultimately, where I was supposed to land at 2:10 PM and be there with my family and help with the rituals, I reached at 8:00 PM, a delay of almost 6 hours. Had I waited for that long to reach Delhi, I would have got a flight for Rs. 13k instead of the 25k I had paid to reach on time.

Hence, while coming back, not wanting to take a chance at all, I booked a Jet flight and I did reach on time, in spite of all the smog. For all my future travels, 1 thing is for sure that I will never fly Indigo, and I would urge all others to never use this flight because of their incessant lack of customer understanding. They are becoming over confident who play with their customers' emotions and I can only see them land in a trough in the near future.

title: An international flight with nothing but water !
text:
I and my partner made a trip to Dubai from Delhi during Diwali time. Del to Dubai we took the Jet Airways flight where hot food and drinks were served. It was a relaxing trip with food in our bellies so we went off to sleep however the trip back we booked Indigo flight. 

What a shock we were in for ! Our flight was at 7 pm and as we were hungry we had a good bite to eat in the superb airport in Dubai itself never realising that we would have starved the almost three hours of flight back home. 

We were under the assumption that food was also included in the fares for international flights (we know domestic there is no food given and we have to buy it) and were shocked to hear that we can get only water and the food has to be purchased not in indian rupees but in US dollars. The pricing was very high, a bottle of mineral water was USD 3, tea/coffee all USD 3, food cost USD 5. 

Makemytrip through which I had booked the flight tickets did not inform us about this. Neither did it inform that we can carry 30 kg instead of 20 kg checked in baggage due to which we hardly purchased anything in Dubai.

Back to Indigo, we saw mostly labourers and workers in the plane and not one passenger bought anything. We were lucky to have had something to eat in the airport but what about the rest. I felt really bad when I saw one guy asking for biryani to a hostess and she told him he has to pay for it.

How can an international flight charge for the food and drinks I cannot understand. When I asked the hostess the reason, she said it is low cost airlines but we paid almost the same fare as Jet Airways so how come they give food and Indigo does not give. It is all very well they are on time and in fact they were one of the best airlines sometime back and I used to travel only with Indigo however nowadays there are lots of delays and no food and I see exactly the same fare for Air India, Jet, Vistara who all provide food on their flights.

Another most important thing Indigo missed out was distributing immigration cards for the foreigners before landing. My partner is from UK and usually the hostess passes out the cards but Indigo did not and when we arrived at the airport he had big issues at the immigration counter. Maybe the airlines will not distribute this also due to low cost airlines. 

I will never travel international by Indigo again.

title: Indigo Airlines - Well Organised Scam with excess fees
text:
As far as my responsibility as a passenger considered,  I booked for excess baggage online. I was asked to pay INR 500 for extra 8 kgs (international excess baggage online price)

Now on reaching the airport I was told that I do not have any excess baggage booked. 

I asked :- How can this be the case if I have already paid for it online and funds has been debited from my account. 

On inquiring from the bank I was told that funds have been cleared to indigo. 

Since I had to catch the flight I was forced to pay INR 1800 at the counter in Delhi. So now I am INR 2300 (INR 1800 + INR 500) out of pocket. 

I asked Indigo to investigate my case and see what has happened. Where the money has gone ? If Indigo is able to locate the funds and identify that I had paid the money (INR 500) in the first place then I should be refunded the INR 1800 that I have been charged wrongfully at the airport as clearly that's a negligence on Indigo side and not of my own . 

Indigo is running a scam where they deliberately loose the funds of fellow passengers who have paid online and pressure them to pay more money at the airport and charge higher penalty fees. Once you have paid the higher fees they will apologies for the mistake and pay you the fees that you have paid online. 

This can be seen as fraud and illegal as Indigo is playing on the vulnerability of the passengers without any repatriations.
